defEn: Having given oneself up to vice; immoral; extremely wicked, or sinning without restraint; irreclaimably wicked.
No longer maintained by its former owners, residents, or caretakers; forsaken, deserted.

examples.en: I feel abandoned by the only woman I love.
examples.tr: Ben, sevdiğim tek kadın tarafından terk edilmiş hissediyorum.

examples.en: The legend says he was abandoned in the woods.
examples.author: CM
examples.tr: Efsane ormanda terk edildiğini söylüyor.

examples.en: This house is abandoned. All the windows are boarded up.
examples.author: Hybrid
examples.tr: Bu ev terk edilmi. Bütün pencereler tahta çakarak kapatılmış.

defEn: In an abnormal manner; in a way that deviates from a standard, norm, or average.

examples.en: The price of real estate has been rising abnormally in Japan.
examples.tr: Japonya'da gayrimenkul fiyatları anormal bir biçimde artıyor.

examples.en: Her nose is abnormally large.
examples.author: Jesse
examples.tr: Onun burnu aşırı derecede büyük.

examples.en: Yanni's dog was abnormally large for his breed.
examples.author: Amastan

defEn: To end a law, system, institution, custom or practice.

examples.en: An overwhelming majority voted to abolish the brutal punishment.
examples.author: Dejo
examples.tr: Ezici bir çoğunluk acımasız cezanın kaldırılması için oy kullandı.

examples.en: The regulation was abolished, but then it was reenacted.
examples.author: CM
examples.tr: Düzenleme kaldırıldı ama sonra yeniden yürürlüğe kondu.

examples.en: Almost every European country has abolished the death penalty.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Neredeyse her Avrupa ülkesi idam cezasını kaldırdı.

defEn: First according to historical or scientific records; original; indigenous; primitive.
Living in a land before colonization by foreigners.

examples.en: Many aboriginal people avoid medical care to avoid discrimination.
examples.author: Amastan

examples.en: To treat his diseases, Daniel uses traditional aboriginal medicines.
examples.author: Amastan

examples.en: I have the body of an original aboriginal.
examples.author: Eccles17

defEn: In an abrupt manner; without giving notice, or without the usual forms; suddenly; precipitously.

examples.en: The conversation ended abruptly when Tom entered the room.
examples.author: CM
examples.tr: Tom odaya girdiğinde konuşma aniden sona erdi.

examples.en: If these drugs are stopped abruptly, then some withdrawal symptoms may occur.
examples.author: patgfisher
examples.tr: Bu ilaçlar aniden kesilirse bazı yoksunluk belirtileri görülebilir.

examples.en: The taxi abruptly turned left.
examples.author: CM
examples.tr: Taksi aniden sola döndü.

defEn: A person who is absent from his or her employment, school, post, duty, etc.
Designating a person absent in a particular capacity, sometimes implying that they are difficult to contact, unresponsive, avoiding their responsibilities, etc.

examples.en: You can vote by absentee ballot.
examples.author: orcrist
examples.tr: Mektupla oy kullanabilirsin.

examples.en: The traveler sent in an absentee vote by mail.
examples.author: swolesuki

examples.en: The absentee landlord requires a state to enforce his claims to the property.
examples.author: shekitten

defEn: Contrary to reason or propriety; obviously and flatly opposed to manifest truth; inconsistent with the plain dictates of common sense; logically contradictory;…
Having no rational or orderly relationship to people's lives; meaningless; lacking order or value.

examples.en: You cannot achieve the impossible without attempting the absurd.
examples.author: Zifre
examples.tr: Sen saçmayı denemeden imkansıza ulaşamazsın.

examples.en: We thought it was absurd that you got punished.
examples.author: Scott
examples.tr: Senin cezalandırılmanın saçma olduğunu düşündük.

examples.en: Clothes with absurd designs are usually more visually striking.
examples.author: misi2991
examples.tr: Absürt dizaynlı kıyafetler genellikle daha estetikler.

defEn: Improper treatment or usage; application to a wrong or bad purpose; an unjust, corrupt or wrongful practice or custom.
Misuse; improper use; perversion.

examples.en: If you abuse your computer, it won't work well.
examples.author: Source_VOA
examples.tr: Bilgisayarını doğru kullanmazsan, iyi çalışmaz.

examples.en: We need to put a stop to this abuse.
examples.author: Amastan
examples.tr: Bu istismara bir nokta koymamız gerekir.

examples.en: Every person has the power to abuse their privileges.
examples.author: slyfin
examples.tr: Her kişi, ayrıcalıklarını kötüye kullanma gücüne sahiptir.

defEn: To gain or obtain access to.
To have access to (data).

examples.en: I often use SSH to access my computers remotely.
examples.author: sysko
examples.tr: Uzak bilgisayarlarıma erişmek için sık sık SSH'ı kullanırım.

examples.en: For some reason I couldn't access my e-mail account.
examples.author: etala
examples.tr: Bir nedenle e-posta hesabıma ulaşamadım.

examples.en: I wasn't able to access all of the information.
examples.author: Joseph
examples.tr: Bilginin tümüne erişemiyordum.

defEn: The quality of being accessible, or of admitting approach; receptiveness.
Features that increase software usability for users with certain impairments.

examples.en: The goal is accessibility.
examples.author: CM
examples.tr: Amaç erişilebilirliktir.

examples.en: We want to achieve accessibility and inclusion for all.
examples.author: Amastan

examples.en: Offering a dark mode is necessary for interface accessibility.
examples.author: frpzzd

defEn: Lodging in a dwelling or similar living quarters afforded to travellers in hotels or on cruise ships, or students, etc.
The act of fitting or adapting, or the state of being fitted or adapted; adaptation; adjustment.

examples.en: I didn't know that Tom lives in student accommodation.
examples.author: sundown
examples.tr: Tom'un öğrenci yurdunda kaldığını bilmiyordum.

examples.en: He called a hotel for accommodations.
examples.author: Zifre
examples.tr: O, konaklama için bir otel aradı.

examples.en: We are looking for lodging accommodations.
examples.author: yulesan
examples.tr: Pansiyon konaklama arıyoruz.

defEn: In natural sequence; consequently; so.
Agreeably; correspondingly; suitably.

examples.en: You must assess the situation and act accordingly.
examples.author: sundown
examples.tr: Durumu tartmalı ve ona göre hareket etmelisin.

examples.en: She is an adult, so you should treat her accordingly.
examples.author: CM
examples.tr: O bir yetişkin, bu yüzden ona ona uygun davranmalısın.

examples.en: We suggest you adjust your records accordingly.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Kayıtlarınızı gereğince ayarlamanızı öneririz.

defEn: To heap up in a mass; to pile up; to collect or bring together (either literally or figuratively), often gradually and without active intent.
To gradually grow or increase in quantity or number.

examples.en: The merchant accumulated tremendous fortune during the postwar era.
examples.tr: Tüccar, savaş sonrası döneminde muazzam servet biriktirdi.

examples.en: The snow that accumulated in the streets blocked traffic.
examples.author: AlanF_US
examples.tr: Sokaklarda biriken kar, trafiği engelledi.

examples.en: How much stuff have you accumulated over the years?
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Yıllar içinde ne kadar çok şey topladınız?

defEn: The act of accusing.
An allegation.

examples.en: I can't find any evidence to support your accusation.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Ben senin suçlamanı destekleyecek bir kanıt bulamıyorum.

examples.en: Unlike what we expected, the accusations were not made.
examples.author: mervert1
examples.tr: Beklenenin aksine, suçlamalar yapılmadı.

examples.en: She didn't come here to defend herself against these accusations.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Kendini bu suçlamalara karşı korumak için buraya gelmedi.

defEn: To suffer pain; to be the source of, or be in, pain, especially continued dull pain; to be distressed.

examples.en: I have a fever and I ache all over.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Ateşim var ve her yerim ağrıyor.

examples.en: I'm aching to tell this good news to my family.
examples.author: CM
examples.tr: Bu iyi haberi aileme söylemeye can atıyorum.

examples.en: I was aching to tell her the secret.
examples.author: CM
examples.tr: Ona sırrı anlatmak için can atıyordum.

defEn: Capable of being achieved, which either means possible or probable.
Not linked to fate or outside influences.

examples.en: Grandmaster is the highest achievable title in chess.
examples.author: danieljtah
examples.tr: Büyükusta satrançta en yüksek ulaşılabilir unvandır.

examples.en: I think your dreams are achievable.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Sanırım hayallerin ulaşılabilir.

examples.en: The first goal seems achievable.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: İlk hedef ulaşılabilir gibi görünüyor.

defEn: A sour substance.
Any corrosive substance.

examples.en: Carbonic acid is a product of many chemical reactions.
examples.author: mailohilohi
examples.tr: Karbonik asit birçok kimyasal reaksiyonun bir ürünüdür.

examples.en: Acid rain in drinking water affects human health.
examples.author: katix824
examples.tr: İçme suyundaki asit yağmuru insan sağlığını etkiler.

examples.en: Acid fruits like pineapples and lemons are sour.
examples.author: gin
examples.tr: Ananas ve limon gibi asitli meyveler ekşidir.

defEn: The act or process of acquiring.
The thing acquired or gained; a gain.

examples.en: The consolidation of the industry continues with today's acquisition.
examples.author: Tangobango
examples.tr: Sanayinin konsolide edilmesi, bugünkü kazançla devam ediyor.

examples.en: Matt is a powerful acquisition for our team.
examples.author: bonney12
examples.tr: Matt ekibimiz için güçlü bir kazanımdır.

examples.en: This is the latest acquisition to my library.
examples.author: Dejo
examples.tr: Bu benim kütüphaneme olan en son katılımdır.

defEn: In an active manner.
In the active form; not passive.

examples.en: Yanni actively encouraged kids from rough neighborhoods to play soccer.
examples.author: Amastan
examples.tr: Yanni gariban mahallelerdeki çocukları futbola yönlendirmek için gayret sarf ediyordu.

examples.en: Sami was actively stalking Layla.
examples.author: OsoHombre
examples.tr: Sami aktif olarak gizlice Leyla'yı takip ediyordu.

examples.en: He became actively involved with the Nation of Islam.
examples.author: Amastan

defEn: Existing in reality, not just potentially; really acted or acting; occurring in fact.
in action at the time being; now existing; current.

examples.en: The actual price was lower than I had thought.
examples.author: al_ex_an_der
examples.tr: Gerçek fiyat düşündüğümden daha aşağıdaydı.

examples.en: The actual cost was higher than the estimate.
examples.author: CM
examples.tr: Gerçek bedel tahmin edilenden daha yüksekti.

examples.en: They shot the film in an actual desert.
examples.author: CM
examples.tr: Filmi gerçek bir çölde çektiler.

defEn: Brief, quick, short.
High or shrill.

examples.en: A dog has an acute sense of smell.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Bir köpeğin keskin bir koku alma duyusu vardır.

examples.en: He felt an acute pain in his chest.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Göğsünde akut bir ağrı hissetti.

examples.en: A blind person's hearing is often very acute.
examples.author: CM
examples.tr: Kör bir insanın işitme duyusu genellikle çok keskindir.

defEn: Capable of being adapted.
Willing or able to adapt to circumstances; flexible.

examples.en: This story may be adaptable for a television program.
examples.tr: Bu hikaye, bir televizyon programı için uyarlanmış olabilir.

examples.en: I think Tom is adaptable.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Tom'un uygun olduğunu düşünüyorum.

examples.en: Tom isn't very adaptable.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Tom çok uyumlu değil.

defEn: A person who is addicted, especially to a harmful drug.
An adherent or fan (of something).

examples.en: She said that her mother was a drug addict.
examples.author: Amastan
examples.tr: Annesinin bir uyuşturucu bağımlısı olduğunu söyledi.

examples.en: This former child actor later became a drug addict.
examples.author: Hybrid
examples.tr: Bu eski çocuk oyuncu daha sonra bir uyuşturucu bağımlısı oldu.

examples.en: You could say that Mrs. Smith is a television addict.
examples.author: CN
examples.tr: Smith Hanımın televizyon bağımlısı olduğunu söyleyebilirsiniz.

defEn: Having a biochemical addiction.
Devoted to or obsessed with something.

examples.en: Many criminals in America are addicted to drugs.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Amerika'daki çoğu suçlu, uyuşturucuya bağımlıdır.

examples.en: Sami was addicted to drugs and facing divorce.
examples.author: OsoHombre
examples.tr: Sami uyuşturucu bağımlısıydı ve boşanma ile karşı karşıyaydı.

examples.en: A person who is addicted to work is called a workaholic.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Çalışma bağımlısı bir kişiye işkolik denilir.

defEn: The state of being addicted; devotion; inclination.
A habit or practice that damages, jeopardizes or shortens one's life but when ceased causes trauma.

examples.en: Smoking is not a habit; it's an addiction.
examples.author: Chrikaru
examples.tr: Sigara içmek alışkanlık değildir; bir bağımlılıktır.

examples.en: Tom stole several credit cards to fund his addiction.
examples.author: Eccles17
examples.tr: Tom bağımlılığını finanse etmek için Tom birkaç kredi kartını çaldı.

examples.en: Smoking is no habit but an addiction.
examples.author: BraveSentry
examples.tr: Sigara içmek bir alışkanlık değil ama bir bağımlılıktır.

defEn: By way of addition; in addition to; also.

examples.en: Precisely speaking, I need six hours to at least think straight. Additionally, I need seven hours to be happy.
examples.author: gleki
examples.tr: Kesin olarak konuşursam, sağlıklı düşünmek için en az altı saate ihtiyacım var. Ayrıca mutlu olmak için yedi saate ihtiyacım var.

examples.en: Additionally, there are hungry sharks in the lake.
examples.author: Amastan

examples.en: Additionally, Walid and Karima have ample personalities.
examples.author: Wassnen

defEn: Equal to or fulfilling some requirement.

examples.en: The pay is not adequate for a family of six.
examples.tr: Maaş altı kişilik bir aile için yeterli değildir.

examples.en: Is your salary adequate to support your family?
examples.author: CM
examples.tr: Maaşın aileni geçindirmen için yeterli mi?

examples.en: He took adequate clothes for a weekend trip.
examples.tr: Hafta sonu gezisi için yeterince kıyafet aldı.

defEn: In an adequate manner.
Sufficient to satisfy a requirement or meet a need; sufficiently; satisfactorily.

examples.en: Uranus hasn't been adequately probed.
examples.author: shekitten
examples.tr: Uranüs, uzay sondası gönderilip yeterince incelenmedi.

examples.en: Everyone should prepare adequately.
examples.author: CM
examples.tr: Herkesin yeterince hazırlanması gerekir.

examples.en: Never attribute to malice that which is adequately explained by stupidity.
examples.author: deniko

defEn: The action of adjusting something.
The result of adjusting something; a small change; a minor correction; a modification or alteration.

examples.en: She made a quick adjustment to her new job.
examples.author: sharptoothed
examples.tr: Yeni işine hızlı bir şekilde uyum sağladı.

examples.en: The adjustment of the machinery was taken care of by engineers.
examples.author: sharptoothed
examples.tr: Makinenin ayarlaması mühendisler tarafından halledildi.

examples.en: You can adjust the seat height by moving the adjustment lever up.
examples.author: fcbond
examples.tr: Ayar kolunu yukarı doğru hareket ettirerek koltuk yüksekliğini ayarlayabilirsiniz.

defEn: Of or relating to administering or administration.

examples.en: Please forward the document to the administrative office for review.
examples.author: sundown
examples.tr: Lütfen incelemesi için belgeyi idari ofise gönderin.

examples.en: The city is divided into ten administrative districts.
examples.author: sharptoothed
examples.tr: Kent, on idari bölgeye ayrılmıştır.

examples.en: Ankara is the administrative capital of Turkey.
examples.author: soliloquist
examples.tr: Ankara Türkiye'nin idari başkentidir.

defEn: Deserving of the highest esteem or admiration; estimable.
Good or heroic.

examples.en: Your motive was admirable, but your action was not.
examples.author: papabear
examples.tr: Senin güdün takdire değer fakat eylemin değmez.

examples.en: He made an admirable speech about protecting the environment.
examples.tr: O, çevreyi koruma hakkında takdire şayan bir konuşma yaptı.

examples.en: Your essay is admirable in regard to style.
examples.author: Zifre
examples.tr: Stilini göz önünde bulundurursak deneme yazın harika.

defEn: In an admiring manner.

examples.en: Tom watched admiringly.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Tom hayranlıkla izledi.

examples.en: Tom smiled admiringly.
examples.author: CM
examples.tr: Tom hayranlıkla gülümsedi.

examples.en: He looked admiringly at his father.
examples.author: ToxicFriu

defEn: As is acknowledged to be true; by general admission; confessedly.
Signals a concession followed by a counterpoint usually headed by but.

examples.en: She is a beauty, admittedly, but she has her faults.
examples.author: CM
examples.tr: Hiç kuşkusuz o bir güzel, ama onun hataları var.

examples.en: He is admittedly an able leader.
examples.author: CM
examples.tr: O hiç kuşkusuz yetenekli bir lider.

examples.en: Admittedly, it wasn't the best meal I've ever eaten.
examples.author: eastasiastudent

defEn: Having been received into a relationship (especially a filial relationship) through adoption; adoptive.
Having been assumed, chosen.

examples.en: In December of that year, a new Constitution was adopted.
examples.author: DJ_Saidez
examples.tr: O yılın aralık ayında, yeni bir anayasa kabul edildi.

examples.en: How many years ago did you realize you were adopted?
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Kaç yıl önce evlat edinildiğini fark ettin?

examples.en: Some orphans will be adopted, but not all.
examples.author: LB
examples.tr: Bazı öksüzler evlatlık alınacak, ama hepsi değil.

defEn: The act of adopting.
The state of being adopted; the acceptance of a child of other parents as if they were one's own child.

examples.en: The puppy's single good eye begs me for adoption.
examples.author: papabear
examples.tr: Yavru köpeğin tek iyi gözü benimseme için yalvarıyor.

examples.en: Tom's biological parents gave him up for adoption.
examples.author: Hybrid
examples.tr: Tom'un biyolojik ebeveynleri onu evlatlık verdi.

examples.en: How do you feel about adoption?
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Evlat edinme hakkında ne düşünüyorsunuz?

defEn: To worship.
To love with one's entire heart and soul; regard with deep respect and affection.

examples.en: Sami was Layla's first grandchild and she adored him.
examples.author: OsoHombre
examples.tr: Sami, Leyla'nın ilk torunuydu ve onu çok seviyordu.

examples.en: Tom adores Mary and follows her everywhere she goes.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Tom, Mary'ye tapıyor ve onun gittiği her yerde onu takip ediyor.

examples.en: The students adore the new English teacher.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Öğrenciler yeni İngilizce öğretmenlerini çok seviyor.

defEn: To make more beautiful and attractive; to decorate.

examples.en: They adorned the room with flowers.
examples.tr: Onlar odayı çiçeklerle süslemişler.

examples.en: The violets adorn my kitchen windows.
examples.author: dynamo
examples.tr: Menekşeler benim mutfak pencerelerini süslüyor.

examples.en: The ornate cornice adorned the top of the building.
examples.author: Amastan

defEn: A forward move; improvement or progression.
An amount of money or credit, especially given as a loan, or paid before it is due; an advancement.

examples.en: We bought our plane tickets two months in advance.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Uçak biletlerimizi iki ay önceden aldık.

examples.en: I'd like you to pay the money in advance.
examples.author: CM
examples.tr: Parayı peşin ödemeni istiyorum.

examples.en: I went to bed after preparing everything in advance.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Ben her şeyi önceden hazırlandıktan sonra yatağa gittim.

defEn: The act of advancing; promotion to a higher place or dignity
The state of being advanced

examples.en: The advancement of modern medicine was a long process.
examples.author: piksea
examples.tr: Modern tıbbın ilerlemesi uzun bir süreçti.

examples.en: Does this job offer opportunities for advancement?
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Bu iş, ilerleme için fırsatlar sunuyor mu?

examples.en: Wolfgang works for the Max Planck Society for the Advancement of Science.
examples.author: Hybrid
examples.tr: Wolfgang "Bilimin İlerlemesi için Max Planck Topluluğu" için çalışır.

defEn: Arrival; onset; a time when something first comes or appears; the time when it is approaching.

examples.en: The tribe wasn't delighted about the advent of the peacemaker.
examples.author: Lepotdeterre
examples.tr: Kabile arabulucunun gelişi hakkında memnun değildi.

examples.en: The advent of the euro is the beacon for the new millennium.
examples.author: alcalino
examples.tr: Euronun gelişi yeni binyılın işaretidir.

examples.en: Carriages gradually disappeared with the advent of the motorcar.

defEn: Inclined to adventure; willing to take risks; prone to embark on hazardous enterprises; daring.
Full of risks; risky; liable to be in danger; requiring courage; rash.

examples.en: What's the most adventurous thing you've ever done?
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Yaptığın en macera dolu şey neydi?

examples.en: Try new or difficult things, be adventurous.
examples.author: Bart_Demeyere
examples.tr: Yeni ve zor şeyleri dene, maceraperest ol.

examples.en: Tom is adventurous, but Mary isn't.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Tom maceraperest, ama Mary değil.

defEn: Unfavorable; antagonistic in purpose or effect; hostile; actively opposing one's interests or wishes; contrary to one's welfare; acting against; working in an…
Opposed; contrary; opposing one's interests or desire.

examples.en: Our plane was cancelled because of adverse weather conditions.
examples.author: Dani6187
examples.tr: Hava muhalefeti nedeniyle uçuşumuz iptal oldu.

examples.en: Is there any adverse reaction?
examples.author: CM
examples.tr: Herhangi bir olumsuz reaksiyon var mı?

examples.en: Many intelligent people are not adverse to sex.
examples.author: nonong

defEn: In an adverse manner.

examples.en: A stressful environment adversely affects a child's cognitive development.
examples.author: CarpeLanam

examples.en: How concerned are you about identity theft adversely affecting you?
examples.author: CM

examples.en: Bending the cable too tightly can also adversely affect signal quality.
examples.author: celeriac

defEn: The state of adverse conditions; state of misfortune or calamity.
An event that is adverse; calamity.

examples.en: She carries on smiling even in the face of adversity.
examples.author: auxitt
examples.tr: O sıkıntıyla karşılassa bile gülümsemeyi sürdürür.

examples.en: Despite adversity, the architect achieved worldwide fame.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Sıkıntıya rağmen, mimar dünya çapında üne ulaştı.

examples.en: We've had a lot of adversity.
examples.author: CM
examples.tr: Çok sıkıntımız vardı.

defEn: Having affection or warm regard; loving; fond.
Characterised by or proceeding from affection; indicating love; tender.

examples.en: I have a tortoiseshell cat. She is so affectionate!
examples.author: memries
examples.tr: Benim bir tekir kedim var. O çok sevecen.

examples.en: He is always very affectionate with his relatives.
examples.tr: O her zaman akrabalarına karşı çok sevecendir.

examples.en: A correct answer is like an affectionate kiss.
examples.author: Adelpa
examples.tr: Doğru bir cevap bir sevgi öpücüğü gibidir.

defEn: In an affectionate manner.

examples.en: The girl squeezed her doll affectionately.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Kız şevkâtle bebeğini kucakladı.

examples.en: Tom smiled at Mary affectionately.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Tom sevgiyle Mary'ye gülümsedi.

examples.en: The third movement affectionately parodies village musicians and their playing.
examples.author: al_ex_an_der

defEn: Able to be afforded; inexpensive or reasonably priced.

examples.en: There is an urgent need for affordable housing.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Ekonomik konuta acil bir ihtiyaç vardır.

examples.en: I just want an affordable place to live.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Ben sadece yaşamak için uygun fiyatlı bir yer istiyorum.

examples.en: Solar power has become much more affordable in recent years.
examples.author: Hybrid
examples.tr: Güneş enerjisi son yıllarda çok daha uygun fiyatlı hale geldi.

defEn: Having existed for so great a period of time that its longevity cannot be expressed.
Continuing infinitely or indefinitely.

examples.en: Only the body can grow old, the soul is ageless.
examples.author: carlosalberto

examples.en: The mountains stood in silent, ageless majesty beneath the stars.
examples.author: rul

examples.en: You can use a program to compress the file.
examples.author: ddnktr

defEn: An increase in density; the act of compressing, or the state of being compressed; compaction.
The deviation of a heavenly body from a spherical form.

examples.en: How long should I wear compression stockings after surgery?
examples.author: Igider

examples.en: Carnot machines work according to cycles of compression and expansion.
examples.author: marcelostockle

examples.en: He has a compression fracture of the spine.
examples.author: AlanF_US

defEn: To bind by mutual agreement.
To adjust and settle by mutual concessions; to compound.

examples.en: Both sides had to compromise with each other.
examples.author: sundown
examples.tr: Her iki taraf birbirleriyle uzlaşmak zorundaydı.

examples.en: He had refused to compromise on the issue.
examples.author: Source_VOA
examples.tr: Konuyla ilgili uzlaşmayı reddetmişti.

examples.en: We never seem to be able to compromise on anything.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Her şeyde uzlaşabilecek gibi görünmüyoruz.

defEn: Required; obligatory; mandatory.
Having the power of compulsion; constraining.

examples.en: In Japan, attendance at elementary and junior high school is compulsory.
examples.tr: Japonya'da ilk ve ortaokula gitmek zorunludur.

examples.en: Attendance is compulsory for all members.
examples.author: CM
examples.tr: Katılmak bütün üyeler için zorunludur.

examples.en: Compulsory military service exists in Turkey.
examples.author: AKINCI81
examples.tr: Türkiye'de zorunlu askerlik vardır.

defEn: To reckon, calculate.
To make sense. (commonly used in mimicry of a science fictional robot and spoken in a robotic voice; most frequently in negative constructs)

examples.en: Scientists can easily compute the distance between planets.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Bilimciler gezegenler arasındaki uzaklıkları kolayca hesaplayabilir.

examples.en: Boys are more interested in engineering and computing than girls.
examples.author: Hybrid
examples.tr: Mühendislik ve bilgisayar alanında erkekler kızlara göre daha ilgili.

examples.en: Can you compute the distance of the moon from the earth?
examples.author: jakov
examples.tr: Ayın dünyadan uzaklığını hesaplayabilir misin?

defEn: To hide something from view or from public knowledge, to try to keep something secret.

examples.en: She concealed the change in her feelings toward him.
examples.author: Zifre
examples.tr: Ona karşı duygularındaki değişimi gizledi.

examples.en: There is nothing concealed that will not be revealed.
examples.author: aandrusiak
examples.tr: Açığa çıkartılmayacak hiçbir sır yoktur.

examples.en: To save your credit, you must conceal your loss.
examples.author: sacredceltic
examples.tr: Kredini kurtarmak için kaybını gizlemelisin.

defEn: To yield or suffer; to surrender; to grant
To grant, as a right or privilege; to make concession of.

examples.en: The accountant would not concede the mistake.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Muhasebeci hatayı kabul etmezdi.

examples.en: The professor I was arguing with finally conceded and said I was right.
examples.author: DostKaplan
examples.tr: Tartıştığım profesör sonunda haklı olduğumu kabul etti.

examples.en: That goalkeeper hasn't conceded a goal in the last 10 matches.
examples.author: DJ_Saidez
examples.tr: O kaleci son 10 maçtır kalesini gole kapadı.

defEn: The faculty of conceiving ideas; mental faculty; apprehension.
Quickness of apprehension; active imagination; lively fancy.

examples.en: He is so full of conceit that everybody dislikes him.
examples.author: CM
examples.tr: O herkesin ondan hoşlanmadığı düşüncesiyle çok dolu.

examples.en: Conceit, arrogance and egotism are the essentials of patriotism.
examples.author: shekitten

examples.en: Her conceit about her beauty annoyed many people.
examples.author: AlanF_US

defEn: Capable of being conceived or imagined.

examples.en: We've tried every conceivable method, but absolutely nothing works.
examples.author: CM
examples.tr: Biz her akla uygun yöntemi denedik, ama kesinlikle hiçbir şey işe yaramıyor.

examples.en: It is hardly conceivable to me that he will fail.
examples.tr: Onun başarısız olacağı aklıma pek yatmıyor.

examples.en: It's conceivable.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: O, akla uygun.

defEn: To have a child; to become pregnant (with).
To develop; to form in the mind; to imagine.

examples.en: I conceived of the plan while I was smoking.
examples.author: CM
examples.tr: Sigara içerken planı tasarladım.

examples.en: It is not possible to conceive without perceiving.
examples.author: BoriQa
examples.tr: Algılama olmadan yaratmak imkansızdır.

examples.en: I can't conceive how I could have made such a mistake.
examples.author: CM
examples.tr: Böyle bir hatayı nasıl yapmış olabileceğimi anlayamıyorum.

defEn: The act of conceiving.
The state of being conceived; the beginning.

examples.en: Don't forget that wrong conceptions lead to wrong conclusions.
examples.author: marcelostockle
examples.tr: Yanlış fikirlerin yanlış sonuçlara götürdüğünü unutma.

examples.en: Tom had no conception of what fatherhood entailed.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Tom, babalığın gerektirdiği anlayışa sahip değildi.

examples.en: Unfortunately, many Russian citizens have an inadequate conception of what is happening in Kyiv.
examples.author: shanghainese
examples.tr: Ne yazık ki, birçok Rus vatandaşı Kiev'de olanlar hakkında yetersiz görüş sahibidir.

defEn: To relate or belong to; to have reference to or connection with; to affect the interest of; to be of importance to.
To engage by feeling or sentiment; to interest.

examples.en: Don't interfere with matters that do not concern you!
examples.author: Zifre
examples.tr: Seni ilgilendirmeyen konulara karışma!

examples.en: To be truthful, this matter doesn't concern her at all.
examples.author: verdulo
examples.tr: Gerçekçi olmak gerekirse, bu konu onu hiç ilgilendirmez.

examples.en: That's nothing you need to concern yourself with.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Bu kendinizi endişelendirmenizi gereken bir şey değil.

defEn: Regarding, respecting.

examples.en: Are you aware of anything concerning his past life?
examples.author: CM
examples.tr: Onun geçmiş yaşamı ile ilgili bir şeyin farkında mısınız?

examples.en: I have my own opinions concerning politics and religion.
examples.author: Adam9812
examples.tr: Siyaset ve din hakkında benim kendi görüşlerim var.

examples.en: The existing law concerning car accidents requires amending.
examples.tr: Araba kazaları ile ilgili mevcut yasa değişiklikler gerektirir.

defEn: The act of conceding.
A compromise: a partial yielding to demands or requests.

examples.en: We solved the problem by mutual concessions.
examples.tr: Biz karşılıklı ödünlerle sorunu çözdük.

examples.en: We believe that you will be able to make a price concession.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Bir fiyat indirimi yapabileceğinize inanıyoruz.

examples.en: We would appreciate it if you grant us this concession.
examples.author: CM

defEn: Real, actual, tangible.
Equipped with a faithful functor to X (called a base category), in which case C is called a concrete category over X.

examples.en: The collapse of the new concrete platform killed four workers.
examples.author: Amastan
examples.tr: Yeni beton platformun çökmesi, dört işçiyi öldürdü.

examples.en: It's a shame that concrete doesn't burn.
examples.author: niceguydave
examples.tr: Ne yazık ki beton yanmaz.

examples.en: The human femur is tougher than concrete.
examples.author: marcika
examples.tr: İnsanın uyluk kemiği betondan daha serttir.

defEn: A building material created by mixing cement, water, and aggregate such as gravel and sand.
Such a material whose cement is Portland cement or a similar limestone derivative.

examples.en: He broke up the concrete block with a hammer.
examples.author: CM
examples.tr: O, çekiçle beton bloğu kırdı.

examples.en: Coventry is a concrete jungle full of chavs!
examples.author: frenchlearner97
examples.tr: Coventry magandalarla dolu bir beton cangılıdır!

examples.en: This type of concrete has never been used in Singapore.
examples.author: Amastan
examples.tr: Bu türde beton, Singapur'da hiç kullanılmamıştır.

defEn: To strongly criticise or denounce; to excoriate.
To judicially pronounce (someone) guilty.

examples.en: All the people who had been condemned were killed.
examples.author: CarpeLanam
examples.tr: Mahkum edilen tüm insanlar öldürüldü.

examples.en: The doctors were wrong to condemn the couple.
examples.tr: Doktorlar çifti kınamakta hatalıydılar.

examples.en: Today, most people in the world condemn slavery.
examples.author: Source_VOA
examples.tr: Günümüzde dünyadaki çoğu insan köleliği kınıyor.

defEn: To lead; to direct; to be in charge of (people or tasks)
To behave.

examples.en: They conducted the following experiment to collect the data.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Bilgi toplamak için aşağıdaki deneyi yaptı.

examples.en: He conducted us on a tour around the lake.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: O, gölün çevresinde bir tur düzenledi.

examples.en: They conducted a series of experiments under zero gravity.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Sıfır yerçekimi altında bir dizi deney gerçekleştirdiler.

defEn: One who conducts or leads; a guide; a director.
A grooved sound or staff used for directing instruments, such as lithontriptic forceps; a director.

examples.en: He stands alone as a conductor of ballet music.
examples.author: AlanF_US
examples.tr: Bale müzik şefi olarak yalnız başına duruyor.

examples.en: The conductor of this orchestra is a fine musician.
examples.author: Luornu
examples.tr: Bu orkestranın şefi iyi bir müzisyen.

examples.en: You can purchase a ticket from the conductor.
examples.author: Huskion
examples.tr: Biletçiden bir bilet satın alabilirsiniz.

defEn: The fruit of a conifer or a similarly shaped fruit or flower head of certain other plants, such as banksias and proteas.
A unit of volume, applied solely to marijuana and only while it is in a smokable state; roughly 1.5 cubic centimetres, depending on use.

examples.en: Can you give me the definition of a cone?
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Bana bir koninin tanımını verebilir misiniz?

examples.en: I think I'll have one more ice cream cone.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Sanırım bir külah daha dondurma yiyeceğim.

examples.en: How do you say 'pine cones' in your native language?
examples.author: freddy1
examples.tr: 'Pine cones' kelimesi senin ana dilinde nedir?

defEn: The act of consulting together formally; serious conversation or discussion; interchange of views.
A stated meeting of preachers and others, invested with authority to take cognizance of ecclesiastical matters.

examples.en: All in all, the international conference was a success.
examples.author: CM
examples.tr: Her şeyi hesaba katarsak, uluslararası konferans bir başarı idi.

examples.en: She first met him at a conference in Boston.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: O, onunla ilk kez Boston'da bir konferansta karşılaştı.

examples.en: The Prime Minister will hold a press conference tomorrow.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Başbakan yarın bir basın toplantısı düzenleyecek.

defEn: Communication among multiple participants for serious discussion.

examples.en: The employee and his colleagues were video conferencing on what to do about the challenge.
examples.author: swolesuki

examples.en: In Moby Dick, the social conferencing of two whale ships on the open seas is called a "gam".
examples.author: setite

defEn: To admit to the truth, particularly in the context of sins or crimes committed.
To acknowledge faith in; to profess belief in.

examples.en: According to the papers, the man has finally confessed.
examples.author: Eldad
examples.tr: Gazetelere göre adam sonunda itiraf etti.

examples.en: Do you want me to confess to the murder?
examples.author: AlanF_US
examples.tr: Cinayeti kabul etmemi mi istiyorsunuz?

examples.en: Fadil was soon caught and confessed to the murder.
examples.author: OsoHombre
examples.tr: Fadıl çok geçmeden yakalandı ve cinayeti itiraf etti.

defEn: The open admittance of having done something (especially something bad).
A formal document providing such an admission.

examples.en: Sami made a shocking confession to his sister, Layla.
examples.author: OsoHombre
examples.tr: Sami, kız kardeşi Leyla'ya şok edici bir itirafta bulundu.

examples.en: In prison, Robert was asked to sign a confession.
examples.author: Amastan
examples.tr: Hapishanede Robert'tan bir itiraf imzalaması istendi.

examples.en: Why did you sign that confession if it wasn't true?
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Eğer doğru değilse o itirafı neden imzaladın?

defEn: In a confident manner; with confidence; with strong assurance; positively.

examples.en: "Yes, I can do that," Tom replied confidently.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Tom kendinden emin bir şekilde "Evet, bunu yapabilirim," diye yanıt verdi.

examples.en: I decided to present myself as confidently as possible.
examples.author: Nuel

examples.en: She held the bat confidently, ready to hit.
examples.author: Amastan

defEn: To restrict (someone or something) to a particular scope or area; to keep in or within certain bounds.

examples.en: Confine your remarks to the matter we are discussing.
examples.author: CM
examples.tr: Yorumlarını tartıştığımız konuyla sınırla.

examples.en: He has been confined to his bed with illness.
examples.author: sundown
examples.tr: Hastalığından dolayı yatağına hapsedildi.

examples.en: He was confined to a bed for three months.
examples.author: ET
examples.tr: Üç ay yatağa bağımlı kaldı.

defEn: To stand or meet facing, especially in competition, hostility or defiance; to come face to face with.
To deal with.

examples.en: The policeman was confronted by the angry mob.
examples.author: CM
examples.tr: Polis öfkeli kalabalıkla karşı karşıyaydı.

examples.en: I think it's time for me to confront that problem.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Sanırım o sorunla yüzleşmemin zamanıdır.

examples.en: Dan went to Linda's house to confront her.
examples.author: Amastan
examples.tr: Dan onu yüzleştirmek için Linda'nın evine gitti.

defEn: The act of joining, or condition of being joined.
Cooccurrence; coincidence.

examples.en: Bribes are something that arises in conjunction with power organizations.
examples.author: Scott
examples.tr: Rüşvet güç örgütleri ile birlikte ortaya çıkan bir şeydir.

examples.en: A more plausible proposal is the one Leech presented in conjunction with Emmet's theory.
examples.author: CN
examples.tr: Daha makul bir öneri Emmet'in teorisi ile ilgili Leech'in sunduğudur.

examples.en: Private companies have been working in conjunction with local communities.
examples.author: sigavax

defEn: An act or instance of achieving victory through combat; the subjugation of an enemy.
An act or instance of gaining control of or mastery over something, overcoming obstacles.

examples.en: The conquest of İstanbul antedates the discovery of America.
examples.author: MostAssertive
examples.tr: İstanbul'un fethi, Amerika'nın keşfinden önce gelir.

examples.en: This is what is called the Norman Conquest.
examples.tr: Buna Normandiya İstilası denilir.

examples.en: The horse is the noblest conquest ever made by man.
examples.author: Scott
examples.tr: At şimdiye kadar insan tarafından yapılmış en asil fetihtir.

defEn: The ethical or moral sense of right and wrong, chiefly as it affects a person’s own behaviour and forms their attitude to their past actions.
A personification of the moral sense of right and wrong, usually in the form of a person, a being or merely a voice that gives moral lessons and advices.

examples.en: Happiness is simply good health and a bad conscience.
examples.author: mailohilohi
examples.tr: Mutluluk sadece iyi bir sağlık ve kötü bir vicdandır.

examples.en: Science without conscience is only the ruin of the soul.
examples.author: LittleBoy
examples.tr: Vicdan olmadan bilim yalnızca ruhun mahvolmasıdır.

examples.en: Conscience is the knowledge that someone is watching.
examples.author: darinmex
examples.tr: Bilinç birinin izlediği bilgidir.

defEn: The state of being conscious or aware; awareness.
The state or trait of having cognition and sensation; cognition and sensation themselves.

examples.en: Ten minutes after the knockout, the boxer regained consciousness.
examples.author: CM
examples.tr: Nakavttan on dakika sonra boksör yeniden bilincini kazandı.

examples.en: He lost consciousness under the influence of the anesthetic.
examples.author: vgigregg
examples.tr: Uyuşturucu etkisi altında bilincini kaybetti.

examples.en: When I regained consciousness, I was in the hospital.
examples.author: FlamingTofu
examples.tr: Kendime geldiğimde hastanedeydim.

defEn: A process of decision-making that seeks widespread agreement among group members.
General agreement among the members of a given group or community, each member of which exercises some discretion in decision-making and follow-up action.

examples.en: At present, consensus has yet to be reached.
examples.tr: Şu anda, yine de görüş birliğine varılmalı.

examples.en: Can we reach a consensus on this issue?
examples.author: CM
examples.tr: Bu konuda bir görüş birliğine varabilir miyiz?

examples.en: Tom was a consensus builder.
examples.author: CM
examples.tr: Tom bir uzlaşı sağlayıcıydı.

defEn: Voluntary agreement or permission.

examples.en: Without your consent, nothing can be done about it.
examples.author: papabear
examples.tr: Senin rızan olmadan, bu konuda hiçbir şey yapılamaz.

examples.en: I took it for granted that he would consent.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Onun razı olacağına kesin gözüyle baktım.

examples.en: How dare you marry my daughter without my consent?
examples.author: Hybrid
examples.tr: Benim iznim olmadan kızımla evlenmeye nasıl cesaret edersin?

defEn: Significantly; to a degree worth considering.

examples.en: This area has been considerably built up of late.
examples.tr: Bu alan oldukça geç inşa edilmiştir.

examples.en: Your family has considerably increased since my last voyage.
examples.author: Eldad
examples.tr: Son yolculuğumdan beri ailen oldukça arttı.

examples.en: The cost of building the bridge blew out considerably.
examples.author: patgfisher
examples.tr: Köprüyü yapmanın maliyeti oldukça arttı.

defEn: Taking into account.

examples.en: He does well considering that he has no experience.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Hiç tecrübesi olmadığını göz önüne alırsak iyi iş çıkarıyor.

examples.en: I'm considering studying in the United States next year.
examples.author: AMIKEMA
examples.tr: Gelecek yıl Amerika Birleşik Devletleri'nde okumayı düşünüyorum.

examples.en: I'm considering sticking around for a few more days.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Birkaç gün daha takılmayı düşünüyorum.

defEn: Of a regularly occurring, dependable nature.
Compatible, accordant.

examples.en: Your principles are not consistent with your actions.
examples.author: Zifre
examples.tr: Sizin ilkeleriniz eylemleriniz ile tutarlı değil.

examples.en: In addition, our experiments are consistent with our theoretical results.
examples.author: GeeZ
examples.tr: Ek olarak, deneyler, teorik sonuçlarla uyumludur.

examples.en: What's in the Quran is consistent with science.
examples.author: OsoHombre
examples.tr: Kuran'da yazanlar bilimle çelişmez.

defEn: The act or example of consoling; the condition of being consoled.
The prize or benefit for the loser.

examples.en: Alex found consolation in the words of his friend.
examples.author: AlanF_US
examples.tr: Alex arkadaşının sözleriyle teselli buldu.

examples.en: I didn't win, but at least I got a consolation prize.
examples.author: darinmex
examples.tr: Kazanamadım ama en azından bir teselli ödülü aldım.

examples.en: That was our only consolation.
examples.author: cromwellt
examples.tr: O bizim tek tesellimizdi.

defEn: To comfort (someone) in a time of grief, disappointment, etc.

examples.en: The Nintendo DS is a popular handheld game console.
examples.author: Spamster
examples.tr: Nintendo DS popüler bir elde taşınabilir oyun konsoludur.

examples.en: Thank you for consoling me when I was sad.
examples.author: Amastan
examples.tr: Üzgün olduğumda beni teselli ettiğin için sana teşekkür ederim.

examples.en: I knew that I could neither console nor help.
examples.author: Dejo
examples.tr: Ne teselli edebileceğimi ne de yardım edebileceğimi biliyordum.

defEn: Unchanged through time or space; permanent.
Consistently recurring over time; persistent.

examples.en: We have kept in constant touch for twenty years.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Biz yirmi yıldır sürekli görüşüyoruz.

examples.en: My wife's constant nagging really gets on my nerves.
examples.author: CM
examples.tr: Karımın sürekli dırdırı gerçekten sinirlerimi bozuyor.

examples.en: There is nothing in this world constant, but inconstancy.
examples.author: Scott
examples.tr: Bu dünyada değişkenlikten başka sürekli bir şey yoktur.

defEn: To seek the opinion or advice of another; to take counsel; to deliberate together; to confer; to advise.
To advise or offer expertise.

examples.en: You had better consult a doctor about your health.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Sağlığın hakkında bir doktora danışsan iyi olur.

examples.en: How could you take that job without consulting me?
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Bu işi bana danışmadan nasıl alabilirsin?

examples.en: Sami consulted with his lawyer before talking to police.
examples.author: OsoHombre
examples.tr: Sami, polisle konuşmadan önce avukatına danıştı.

defEn: A person or party that is consulted.
A person whose occupation is to be consulted for their expertise, advice, service or help in an area or specialty; a party whose business is to be similarly…

examples.en: I'd like to hire you as a consultant.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Seni bir danışman olarak çalıştırmak istiyorum.

examples.en: Sami asked Layla to become a film consultant.
examples.author: OsoHombre
examples.tr: Sami, Leyla'dan film danışmanı olmasını istedi.

examples.en: Where can I find a good financial consultant?
examples.author: verymuchso
examples.tr: İyi bir finansal danışmanı nerede bulabilirim?

defEn: To make something dangerous or toxic by introducing impurities or foreign matter.
To soil, stain, corrupt, or infect by contact or association.

examples.en: Tom died because he had eaten some contaminated beef.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Tom biraz bozulmuş sığır eti yediği için öldü.

examples.en: These infections were caused by contaminated milk.
examples.author: CM
examples.tr: Bu enfeksiyonlara kirlenmiş süt sebep oldu.

examples.en: The water was contaminated with oil.
examples.author: muggies16
examples.tr: Su petrolle kirletilmiş.

defEn: From the same time period, coexistent in time; contemporaneous.
Modern, of the present age (shorthand for ‘contemporary with the present’).

examples.en: I must admit I don't like much contemporary music.
examples.tr: Çağdaş müziği fazla beğenmediğimi kabul etmeliyim.

examples.en: The professor is familiar with contemporary literature.
examples.tr: Profesör çağdaş edebiyata aşinadır.

examples.en: Contemporary classical music is often very dissonant.
examples.author: mailohilohi
examples.tr: Çağdaş klasik müzik genellikle çok uyumsuzdur.

defEn: The state or act of contemning; the feeling or attitude of regarding someone or something as inferior, base, or worthless; scorn, disdain.
The state of being despised or dishonored; disgrace.

examples.en: I feel nothing but contempt for such behavior.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Böylesine bir davranış için aşağılamaktan başka hiçbir şey hissetmiyorum.

examples.en: He always speaks of the government with contempt.
examples.author: CM
examples.tr: O hükümetten her zaman aşağılayarak bahseder.

examples.en: The best revenge is indifference, contempt.
examples.author: carlosalberto
examples.tr: En iyi intikam ilgisizlik, küçümsemedir.

defEn: Satisfied, pleased, contented.

examples.en: If I had a nickname, I would be content.
examples.author: Muelisto
examples.tr: Bir takma adım olsa memnun olurum.

examples.en: He is content with his life as a baseball player.
examples.author: CM
examples.tr: O bir beyzbol oyuncusu olarak hayatından memnun.

examples.en: They are content with things as they are.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Onlar mevcut durumdan memnun.

defEn: An agreement between two or more parties, to perform a specific job or work order, often temporary or of fixed duration and usually governed by a written…
A period of work agreed to under a temporary contract.

examples.en: The contract states how much we have to pay.
examples.author: Source_VOA
examples.tr: Sözleşme, bizim ne kadar ödemek zorunda olduğumuzu gösterir.

examples.en: Look over the contract well, before you sign it.
examples.tr: İmzalamadan önce sözleşmeyi iyi şekilde gözden geçir.

examples.en: This company and I have signed a three-year contract.
examples.author: hajenso
examples.tr: Bu şirket ve ben üç yıllık bir sözleşme imzaladık.

defEn: To deny the truth or validity of (a statement or statements).
To oppose (a person) by denying the truth or pertinence of a given statement.

defEn: Worthy to be desired; pleasing; agreeable.
Sexually attractive.

defEn: To want; to wish for earnestly.
To put a request to (someone); to entreat.

defEn: The top surface of a desk.
A desktop computer.

examples.tr: Bir dizüstü, bir masaüstünden daha iyidir.

defEn: The act of desolating or laying waste; destruction of inhabitants; depopulation.
The state of being desolated or laid waste

defEn: In a desperate manner; without regard to danger or safety; recklessly.
extremely

defEn: The act of despairing or becoming desperate; a giving up of hope.
A state of despair, or utter hopelessness; abandonment of hope.

examples.author: AlanF_US
examples.tr: İki hafta önce çaresizlikten oraya gittim.

examples.en: Desperation has led him to risk his life.

examples.author: LimeGreenTeknii
examples.tr: Şu anki çaresizliğimi ancak sen anlayabilirsin.

defEn: To regard with contempt or scorn.
To disregard or ignore.

examples.en: The learned are apt to despise the ignorant.

examples.author: CM
examples.tr: Bazı öğrencileri ona hayrandı, diğerleri ise onu küçümsüyordu.

defEn: That to which any person or thing is destined; a predetermined or inevitable eventual state; a condition predestined by the Divine or by human will.
One's eventual fate (not necessarily inevitable or predestined).

examples.tr: Kendi kaderinin kaptanısın.

examples.tr: Kimse kaderden daha bilgili olamaz.

defEn: To take apart from; to take off.
To come off something.

examples.en: He lived detached from all the troubles of our family.
examples.author: marcelostockle
examples.tr: Ailemizin tüm sorunlarından ayrı yaşıyordu.

examples.author: megamanenm
examples.tr: Modern çağda insanlar bağımsızdır.

examples.tr: Hiç retina dekolmanı geçirdiniz mi?

defEn: The action of detaching; separation.
The state of being detached or disconnected; insulation.

examples.en: Does detachment from the world really prevent suffering?
examples.author: AlanF_US
examples.tr: Dünyadan ayrılma acı çekmeyi gerçekten engelliyor mu?

examples.en: I was impressed by his general detachment from others.
examples.author: Nuel

examples.en: My brothers have always shown emotional detachment toward me.
examples.author: Nuel

defEn: Characterized by attention to detail and thoroughness of treatment.

examples.en: Detailed maps of this area have not been drawn.
examples.author: sundown
examples.tr: Bu alan için ayrıntılı haritalar çizilmedi.

examples.author: verdulo

examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Neler olduğuna dair detaylı bir açıklamaya ihtiyacımız var.

defEn: To discover or notice, especially by careful search, examination, or probing.
To work or solve cases as a detective.

examples.en: He was detected in the very act of stealing.
examples.tr: O, tam çalma anında tespit edildi.

examples.en: In Japan, radioactive cesium was detected in baby formula.
examples.author: Scott
examples.tr: Japonya'da bebek mamasında radyoaktif sezyum saptandı.

examples.en: We detected a great fault in the system.
examples.tr: Biz sistemde büyük bir hata belirledik.

defEn: Decided; resolute, possessing much determination; dogged.

examples.en: She was determined never to talk to him again.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: O, onunla tekrar asla konuşmamaya kararlıydı.

examples.en: The date of the event is to be determined.
examples.author: RoseTech
examples.tr: Etkinliğin tarihi belirlenecektir.

examples.en: The cause of death is yet to be determined.
examples.author: Eccles17
examples.tr: Ölüm nedeni henüz belirlenmedi.

defEn: A factor that defines something, or one among several that define it.
Someone or something (especially a sentient agent) that determines; a decider of a disposition.

examples.en: An arbiter is a fair and impartial determiner of fact.
examples.author: LK

examples.en: Is "that" functioning as a pronoun or a determiner here?

examples.author: nonong

defEn: In the process of development.
Of a country: becoming economically more mature or advanced; becoming industrialized.

examples.en: Mankind is developing further.
examples.author: carlosalberto
examples.tr: İnsanlık daha da gelişiyor.

examples.en: I have come to realize that China is developing quickly but the Chinese people live a relatively leisurely life.
examples.author: eastasiastudent
examples.tr: Çin'in hızla geliştiğini anlamak için geldim ancak Çin halkı nispeten acelesiz bir hayat yaşıyor.

examples.en: The urban population in most developing countries is increasing very fast.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Çoğu gelişmekte olan ülkelerde kentsel nüfus çok hızlı artıyor.

defEn: The bad part of the conscience; the opposite to the angel.
A wicked or naughty person, or one who harbors reckless, spirited energy, especially in a mischievous way; usually said of a young child.

examples.author: AqQoyriq_1
examples.tr: Meleklerin iki kanadı, Şeytan'ın bir kuyruğu vardır.

examples.en: Hell is empty, and all the devils are here!
examples.author: Imp
examples.tr: Cehennem boş, tüm şeytanlar burada.

examples.en: Speak of the devil and he is sure to appear.
examples.author: Zifre
examples.tr: İti an, çomağı hazırla.

defEn: to give one's time, focus one's efforts, commit oneself, etc. entirely for, on, or to a certain matter; to consecrate.
to consign over; to doom

examples.en: I want to devote my life to education.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Hayatımı eğitime adamak istiyorum.

examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Hayatımı tarih çalışmasına adayacağım.

examples.author: Tickler

defEn: Vowed; dedicated; consecrated.
Strongly emotionally attached; very fond of someone or something.

examples.tr: Fadıl ve Leyla'nın ikisi de çok fedakar anne babalardı.

examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Tom ve Mary birbirlerine çok bağlılar.

examples.author: CK
examples.tr: O üç çocuğuna içten bağlıdır.

defEn: The watery or very soft excrement that comes from such bowel movements.
A gastrointestinal disorder characterized by frequent and very soft or watery bowel movements.

examples.en: Fecal transplant is an effective treatment for antibiotic-associated diarrhoea.
examples.author: merlin
examples.tr: Dışkı nakli, antibiyotik ile ilişkili ishal için etkili bir tedavi yöntemidir.

defEn: An authoritarian leader of a country, nation, or government.
A tyrannical boss or authority figure.

examples.author: AlanF_US

defEn: To invest with dignity or honour.
To give distinction to.

defEn: Not bright or colorful.

A small amount of money.

defEn: A serious infectious disease leading to inflammation of mucous membranes of the upper respiratory tract, caused by Corynebacterium diphtheriae.

defEn: A document issued by an educational institution testifying that the recipient has earned a degree or has successfully completed a particular course of study.

defEn: A person, such as an ambassador, who is accredited to represent a government officially in its relations with other governments or international organisations
Someone who uses skill and tact in dealing with other people.

examples.tr: Kim gelecekte bir diplomat olmaya niyet ediyor.

examples.tr: O ünlü bir şair ve yetenekli bir diplomattı.

defEn: The action of disappearing or vanishing.

defEn: The act of disapproving; condemnation.

To have or express an unfavorable opinion.

examples.en: My father disapproved of my going to the concert.

examples.tr: Babam konsere gitmemi onaylamadı.

examples.tr: Projemi onaylıyor musun yoksa onaylamıyor musun?

examples.tr: Mary'nin ebeveynleri onun dövme yaptırma kararını onaylamadılar.

defEn: The material thus released.
The act of firing a projectile, especially from a firearm.

examples.author: CM
examples.tr: Benim sol kulağımda bir akıntı var.

examples.en: Your honor, I would like to discharge counsel.
examples.author: MrShoval
examples.tr: Sayın yargıç, danışmanı tahliye etmek istiyorum.

examples.tr: Taburcu olduktan sonra ücretsiz olarak Narcan almayı düşünür müsünüz?

defEn: A person who learns from another, especially one who then teaches others.
An active follower or adherent of someone, or some philosophy etc.

examples.tr: İsa'nın havarilerinden birinin adı Paulus'tu.

examples.tr: Peter İsa'nın müridi olduğunu reddetti.

defEn: A controlled behaviour; self-control.
An enforced compliance or control.

examples.en: Linguistics is the discipline which aims to describe language.
examples.author: bajama
examples.tr: Dilbilim dili tanımlamayı amaçlayan bilim dalıdır.

examples.en: Discipline is the most important part of success.
examples.author: mailohilohi
examples.tr: Başarının en önemli parçası disiplindir.

defEn: To sever or interrupt a connection.
To remove the connection between an appliance and an electrical power source.

examples.en: I called Tom, but his number's been disconnected.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Tom'u aradım ama bağlantısı kesildi.

examples.en: Dan disconnected Linda from her respirator.
examples.author: Amastan
examples.tr: Dan, Linda'yı solunum cihazından ayırdı.

examples.en: I'm not disconnecting their printers.
examples.author: AlanF_US
examples.tr: Onların yazıcılarını ayırmıyorum.

defEn: To harm the good reputation of (a person).
To cause (an idea or piece of evidence) to seem false or unreliable.

examples.en: This utterly discredits him as a scientist.
examples.author: mailohilohi
examples.tr: Bu onu bir bilim adamı olarak tamamen gözden düşürüyor.

examples.en: Tom believes Mary is trying to discredit him.
examples.author: shekitten
examples.tr: Tom, Mary'nin onu kötülemeye çalıştığına inanıyor.

examples.tr: Öğretmen onun itibarsız araştırmasıyla ilgili raporuna dayandırarak ona başarısız notu verdi.

defEn: To make distinctions.
To treat or affect differently, depending on differences in traits.

examples.en: We must be able to discriminate between objects and situations.
examples.author: tabidots
examples.tr: Nesneler ve durumlar arasında ayrım yapabilmeliyiz.

examples.en: Subtle differences in tone discriminate the original from the copy.
examples.author: jakov
examples.tr: Tondaki ince farklar orijinali fotokopiden ayırt eder.

examples.tr: İnsanlara milliyet, cinsiyet veya meslek temelinde ayrımcılık yapmayın.

defEn: The condition of being out of favor; loss of favor, regard, or respect.
The state of being dishonored, or covered with shame.

examples.en: I would rather be killed than live in disgrace.
examples.author: CM
examples.tr: Utanç içinde yaşamaktansa öldürülmeyi tercih ederim.

examples.en: These slums are a disgrace to the city.
examples.tr: Bu gecekondular kent için bir yüz karasıdır.

examples.author: mailohilohi
examples.tr: O, itibarını kaybettiğinde bütün arkadaşları onu terk etti.

examples.tr: Bob maskeli olmasına karşın, ben onu bir bakışta tanıdım.

To avoid giving away or revealing (something secret); to hide by a false appearance.

examples.en: I'm planning to disguise myself as a doctor.
examples.author: AMIKEMA
examples.tr: doktor olarak kılık değiştirmeyi planlıyorum.

examples.en: The thief disguised himself as an old lady.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Hırsız yaşlı bir kadın olarak kendini gizledi.

examples.en: He disguised himself as a salesman and visited her house.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: O bir satıcı kılığına girdi ve onun evini ziyaret etti.

defEn: The characteristic or condition of being dishonest.
An act which is fraudulent or otherwise dishonest.

examples.en: I can't answer for his dishonesty.

examples.en: He charged me with dishonesty.
examples.tr: Beni sahtekarlıkla suçladı.

examples.en: He denounced all forms of dishonesty in government.

defEn: To free or deprive of illusion; to disenchant.

defEn: To leave or withdraw from; to quit; to retire from.
To cause (or help) to leave or withdraw from.

defEn: To draw conclusions from examining; to assess; to appraise.
To compute or determine the value of (an expression).

A completion of a mathematical operation; a valuation.

defEn: Lasting or enduring forever; endless, eternal.
Chiefly of a deity or other supernatural being: having always existed and will continue to exist forever; eternal.

defEn: In a manner which makes the fact or conclusion evident; obviously; as may be clearly inferred.
Apparently.

Morally corrupt.

defEn: Development; the act or result of developing what was implicit in an idea, argument etc.
A process of gradual change in a given system, subject, product etc., especially from simpler to more complex forms.

defEn: To move (something) in regular procession through a system.
To change or transform (something).

defEn: The state of being exact.

The act of exaggerating; the act of doing or representing in an excessive manner; a going beyond the bounds of truth, reason, or justice; a hyperbolical…

defEn: To honor; to hold in high esteem; to praise or worship.
To raise in rank, status etc., to elevate.

The branch of government that is responsible for enforcing laws and judicial decisions, and for the day-to-day administration of the state.

defEn: To display or show (something) for others to see, especially at an exhibition or contest.
To demonstrate.

examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Bu biletle özel sergiyi görebilir miyim?

Someone who is banished from their home or country.

defEn: Foreign, especially in an exciting way.
Non-native to the ecosystem.

examples.tr: Oğlan bir Antarktika seferine gitmeyi hayal ediyordu.

defEn: Extraordinary capable or knowledgeable.

A person who by means of travel (notably an expedition) searches out new information.

Having the character of an explosion.

defEn: Something that is exported.
The act of exporting.

To sell (goods) to a foreign country.

defEn: Effectively conveying thought or feeling.
Conveying the speaker's emotions and/or attitudes, in addition to the denotative or literal meaning.

defEn: Especially or extraordinarily fine or pleasing; exceptional.
Recherché; far-fetched; abstruse.

defEn: The act of extending; a stretching out; enlargement in length, breadth, or time; an increase.
The state of being extended.

Having merely the outward appearance of something.

defEn: Something that is extracted or drawn out.
A portion of a book, document, recording etc. incorporated distinctly in another work (for written or spoken words, synoymous to a citation; a quotation).

examples.tr: İşte kötü diş, çekilmesi gerekiyor.

examples.author: CK

defEn: Causing death or destruction.
Causing a sudden end to the running of a program.

The effect, consequence, outcome, or inevitable events predetermined by this cause.

examples.tr: Yalnız bir hayat yaşamak onun kaderiydi.

examples.en: She had no choice but to accept her fate.

examples.tr: Kaderini kabul etmekten başka seçeneği yoktu.

defEn: A relatively rare or difficult accomplishment.

examples.author: Amastan
examples.tr: Bu büyük baraj, inşaatın inanılmaz bir uyumudur.

examples.tr: Uluslararası uzay istasyonu inanılmaz bir mühendislik başarısıdır.

examples.tr: Yiyecek hayat verir, hayat güç verir ve güç büyük başarılar verir.

examples.tr: Dil ders kitapları sadece iyi insanları ön plana çıkarmaktadır.

examples.tr: Onun filmleri genellikle güçlü kadın karakterleri ön plana çıkarır.

examples.tr: Bana her zaman öğüt vermesinden bıktım.

examples.en: He was fed up with life in the city.
examples.author: CM
examples.tr: O, kentteki yaşamdan bıktı.

examples.en: I'm fed up with always backing you up.
examples.author: CM
examples.tr: Sürekli seni desteklemekten bıktım.

examples.author: Hybrid
examples.tr: Bu muhtıra Resmi Gazete'de yayınlanır.

examples.en: Americans pay both federal taxes and state taxes.
examples.author: CM
examples.tr: Amerikalılar hem federal vergiler hem de devlet vergileri öderler.

examples.en: Twenty people were detained by the Federal Police.
examples.author: marcelostockle
examples.tr: 20 kişi, Federal Polis tarafından gözaltına alındı.

defEn: Critical assessment of a process or activity or of their results.

examples.en: Please review the contents and provide any appropriate feedback.
examples.tr: Lütfen içeriği gözden geçiriniz ve herhangi uygun bir geri bildirim veriniz.

examples.en: The company welcomes feedback from consumers who use their products.
examples.author: thomasstrand
examples.tr: Şirket, ürünlerini kullanan tüketicilerin geri bildirimlerini memnuniyetle karşılıyor.

examples.tr: Bizim için herhangi bir geri bildiriminiz var mı?

defEn: A companion; a comrade.
