examples.author: shekitten
examples.tr: Okul günlerimde aylak olduğum için pişmanım.

examples.en: You are idle to the bone.
examples.author: Zifre
examples.tr: Sen iliklerine kadar boşsun.

examples.en: I thought he was busy, but on the contrary he was idle.
examples.tr: Onun meşgul olduğunu sanıyordum ama tam tersine boştaydı.

defEn: To make an idol of, or to worship as an idol.
To adore excessively; to revere immoderately.

examples.en: I don't understand why people idolize criminals.
examples.author: Hybrid
examples.tr: İnsanların suçluları neden putlaştırdıklarını anlamıyorum.

examples.en: Tom idolized his father.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Tom babasını taparcasına seviyordu.

examples.en: She idolized him.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: O onu idolleştirmişti.

defEn: The condition of being uninformed or uneducated; lack of knowledge or information.
Existential blindness.

examples.en: He took advantage of my ignorance and deceived me.
examples.author: CM
examples.tr: Cehaletimden faydalandı ve beni aldattı.

examples.en: War is peace. Freedom is slavery. Ignorance is strength.
examples.author: Wadimiy
examples.tr: Savaş barıştır. Özgürlük köleliktir. Cahillik güçtür.

examples.en: Science is the belief in the ignorance of experts.
examples.author: Hybrid
examples.tr: Bilim uzmanların cehaletine inançtır.

defEn: Unknowledgeable or uneducated; characterized by ignorance.
Not knowing (a fact or facts), unaware (of something).

examples.en: The masses are entirely ignorant of the segregation problem.
examples.tr: Halk ayrımcılık probleminden tamamen habersiz.

examples.en: He was ignorant of the plot to assassinate him.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Ona suikast yapılacağı planından habersizdi.

examples.en: The learned are apt to despise the ignorant.
examples.author: Zifre
examples.tr: Bilgili insanlar cahil insanları küçümseme eğilimindedir.

defEn: To clarify something by giving, or serving as, an example or a comparison.
To provide a book or other publication with pictures, diagrams or other explanatory or decorative features.

examples.en: Everyone can feed the database to illustrate new vocabulary.
examples.author: jakov
examples.tr: Herkes yeni kelimeleri göstermek için veritabanını besleyebilir.

examples.en: The artist who illustrated this book is very good.
examples.author: _undertoad
examples.tr: Bu kitabı resimlemiş olan sanatçı çok iyi.

examples.en: This yearbook is illustrated with a lot of beautiful photographs.
examples.author: CM
examples.tr: Bu yıllık birçok güzel fotoğrafla süslenmiştir.

defEn: The act of illustrating; the act of making clear and distinct.
The state of being illustrated, or of being made clear and distinct.

examples.en: Here's an illustration at the top of this page.
examples.tr: İşte bu sayfanın tepesinde bir illüstrasyon var.

examples.en: The book's illustrations are very good.
examples.author: _undertoad
examples.tr: Kitabın resimleri çok iyi.

examples.en: This book has 252 pages exclusive of illustrations.
examples.author: AlanF_US
examples.tr: Bu kitabın, çizimler hariç 252 sayfası vardır.

defEn: The work of one who makes images or visible representation of objects.
Imitation work.

examples.en: The poem relies heavily on imagery associated with night.
examples.author: shekitten

examples.en: Govind's company creates computer-generated imagery for blockbuster films.
examples.author: sabretou

examples.en: Imagery makes poetry vivid.
examples.author: Igider

defEn: The act of imitating.
A copy or simulation; something that is not the real thing.

examples.en: What is the difference between imitation and real diamonds?
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Taklit ve gerçek elmaslar arasındaki fark nedir?

examples.en: Compare this genuine jewel with that imitation.
examples.tr: O taklit ile bu gerçek mücevheri karşılaştırın.

examples.en: He compared the imitation with the original.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: O, taklitini orijinali ile karşılaştırdı.

defEn: To place within a fluid (generally a liquid, but also a gas).
To involve or engage deeply.

examples.en: I am rapidly losing the ability of immersing myself in activities that I love.
examples.author: WestofEden
examples.tr: Ben sevdiğim faaliyetlerde kendimi daldırma yeteneğimi hızla kaybediyorum.

examples.en: She immersed herself in the culture of the city.
examples.author: Amastan

examples.en: He immersed himself in the world of the book.
examples.author: Amastan

defEn: A non-native person who comes to a country from another country to permanently settle there.
A plant or animal that establishes itself in an area where it previously did not exist.

examples.en: The majority of the Americans are descended from immigrants.
examples.author: Eldad
examples.tr: Amerikalıların çoğunluğu göçmenlerin soyundan gelmektedir.

examples.en: The second generation of immigrants has only one home.
examples.tr: İkinci nesil göçmenlerin tek bir evleri vardır.

examples.en: The immigrants entered the country in a steady flow.
examples.tr: Göçmenler sürekli bir akış içinde ülkeye giriş yaptılar.

defEn: Breaching principles of natural law, rectitude, or justice, and so inconsistent with the demands of virtue, purity, or "good morals"; not right, not moral.…

examples.en: I'm the most immoral person you'll ever meet.
examples.author: mailohilohi
examples.tr: Karşılaşacağın en ahlaksız kişiyim.

examples.en: It is not immoral to be rich.
examples.author: mailohilohi
examples.tr: Zengin olmak ahlaka aykırı değildir.

examples.en: What you did is immoral.
examples.author: tabular
examples.tr: Yaptığınız ahlak dışıdır.

defEn: Not susceptible to death; living forever; never dying.
Never to be forgotten; that merits being always remembered.

examples.en: A man's body dies, but his soul is immortal.
examples.author: CM
examples.tr: Bir insanın vücudu ölür, ama ruhu ölümsüzdür.

examples.en: The body is mortal, but the soul is immortal.
examples.author: CarpeLanam
examples.tr: Vücut ölümlüdür ancak ruh ölümsüzdür.

examples.en: During these years he wrote immortal poems.
examples.tr: Bu yıllar içerisinde ölümsüz şiirler yazdı.

defEn: Never dying
Being remembered forever

examples.en: I believe in the immortality of the soul.
examples.author: CM
examples.tr: Ruhun ölümsüzlüğüne inanıyorum.

examples.en: Stefan was looking for the tree of immortality.
examples.author: Amastan
examples.tr: Stefan ölümsüzlük ağacını arıyordu.

examples.en: All of us should strive for immortality.
examples.tr: Hepimiz ölümsüzlük için gayret etmeliyiz.

defEn: Treating all parties, rivals, or disputants equally; not partial; not biased.

examples.en: The journalists who write for this publisher are not impartial.
examples.author: sundown
examples.tr: Bu yayıncı için yazan gazeteciler tarafsız değiller.

examples.en: Tom told me that he thought Mary would be impartial.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Tom bana Mary'nin tarafsız olacağını düşündüğünü söyledi.

examples.en: The verdict was fair and impartial.
examples.author: CM
examples.tr: Karar adil ve tarafsızdı.

defEn: In an impatient manner.

examples.en: We are awaiting impatiently the arrival of our dear friend.
examples.tr: Biz sabırsızlıkla sevgili arkadaşımızın gelişini bekliyoruz.

examples.en: All day long today I have been waiting impatiently for you.
examples.author: Bah_Dure
examples.tr: Bugün bütün gündür sabırsızlıkla seni bekliyorum.

examples.en: I'm waiting impatiently for a translation of this sentence into Chinese.
examples.author: rul
examples.tr: Bu cümlenin Çinceye çevrilmesini sabırsızlıkla bekliyorum.

defEn: An essential action, a must: something which is imperative.
The grammatical mood expressing an order (see jussive). In English, the imperative form of a verb is the same as that of the bare infinitive.

examples.en: What a little imp he is!
examples.tr: O ne küçük afacan!

examples.en: It's imperative that you follow the instructions carefully.
examples.author: patgfisher
examples.tr: Dikkatli bir şekilde talimatları izlemek zorundasın.

examples.en: It's imperative to go out.
examples.author: _undertoad
examples.tr: Dışarı çıkmak zorunlu.

defEn: not permanent; unperpetual.

examples.en: Life is impermanent.
examples.author: shekitten
examples.tr: Hayat geçicidir.

examples.en: As you won't live forever, of course, your housing accommodations are impermanent.
examples.author: nonong

defEn: A tool or instrument for working with.

examples.en: These implements are in common use.
examples.author: CM
examples.tr: Bu araçlar ortak kullanımdadır.

examples.en: They bought their children some writing implements for school.
examples.author: Ergulis

examples.en: That tractor implement makes burrows in the field.
examples.author: Eccles17

defEn: To bring about; to put into practice; to carry out.
To realize a technical specification, e.g. of an algorithm, interface, or protocol.

examples.en: Lots of companies have implemented an eight-hour working day.
examples.author: CM
examples.tr: Birçok şirket 8 saatlik bir çalışma günü uygular.

examples.en: I liked your idea and implemented it.
examples.author: Nylez
examples.tr: Düşünceni beğendim ve uygulamaya geçirdim.

examples.en: We implemented our models in C++.
examples.author: AlanF_US
examples.tr: Modellerimizi C ++'ya uyguladık.

defEn: The act of implicating.
The state of being implicated.

examples.en: Her implication in the crime was obvious.
examples.tr: Onun suça karıştığı belliydi.

examples.en: What are the implications of Medea's words?
examples.tr: Medea'nın sözlerinin sonuçları nelerdir?

examples.en: The societal implications of this research are likely to be far-reaching.
examples.author: mailohilohi
examples.tr: Bu araştırmanın toplumsal sonuçları muhtemelen çok geniş kapsamlıdır.

defEn: To have as a necessary consequence; to lead to (something) as a consequence.
To suggest by logical inference.

examples.en: None of them could understand what she was implying.
examples.author: AlanF_US
examples.tr: Onlardan hiçbiri onun ne kastettiğini anlayamadı.

examples.en: He implied that something was wrong with his marriage.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Evliliğinde bir şeyin yanlış olduğunu ima etti.

examples.en: You implied that you knew what you were doing.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Ne yaptığını bildiğini belirttin.

defEn: Not polite; discourteous; not of polished manners; wanting in good manners.

examples.en: I think it is best not to be impolite.
examples.author: Zifre
examples.tr: Sanırım kaba olmamak en iyisi.

examples.en: It was impolite of him not to say goodbye.
examples.author: CM
examples.tr: Hoşça kal dememesi kabalıktı.

examples.en: It's very impolite of you to decline her invitation.
examples.author: CM
examples.tr: Onun davetini geri çevirmen büyük saygısızlık.

defEn: In an impolite manner; uncivilly; rudely.

examples.en: She spoke impolitely.
examples.author: CM
examples.tr: O terbiyesizce konuştu.

examples.en: Tom spoke impolitely.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Tom terbiyesizce konuşur.

examples.en: Ziri spoke impolitely to the nuns.
examples.author: Amastan

defEn: To bring (something) in from a foreign country, especially for sale or trade.
To be important; to be significant; to be of consequence.

examples.en: We import raw materials and export the finished products.
examples.author: papabear
examples.tr: Biz ham madde ithal ederiz ve bitmiş ürünler ihraç ederiz.

examples.en: Japan began to import rice from the United States.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Japonya, Amerika'dan pirinç ithal etmeye başladı.

examples.en: Japan has to import most of its raw materials.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Japonya ham maddelerinin çoğunu ithal etmek zorunda.

defEn: To apply, enforce, or establish (something, often regarded as burdensome as a restriction or tax: see verb sense 1.2.2) with authority.
To place or put (something chiefly immaterial, especially something regarded as burdensome as a duty, an encumbrance, a penalty, etc.) on another thing or on…

examples.en: The government has imposed a new tax on wine.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Hükümet şaraba yeni bir vergi koydu.

examples.en: It is improper to impose sanctions upon the union.
examples.tr: Sendika üzerine yaptırımlar uygulanması uygunsuz.

examples.en: The king imposed heavy taxes on the people.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Kral, halka ağır vergiler koydu.

defEn: Something that is impossible.
The quality of being impossible.

examples.en: In dreams and in love there are no impossibilities.
examples.author: Hybrid
examples.tr: Rüyalarda ve aşkta hiçbir imkânsızlık yoktur.

examples.en: Modern science has turned many impossibilities into possibilities.
examples.author: CM
examples.tr: Modern bilim birçok olanaksızlıkları olanaklı hale dönüştürmüştür.

examples.en: Utopia today means a realisable impossibility.
examples.author: carlosalberto
examples.tr: Bugün ütopya gerçekleşebilir bir imkansızlık anlamına geliyor.

defEn: Not practical; impracticable.

examples.en: We all consider your idea to be impractical.
examples.author: kebukebu
examples.tr: Hepimiz senin fikrinin kullanışsız olduğunu düşünüyoruz.

examples.en: The plan was rejected as being impractical.
examples.author: CM
examples.tr: Plan kullanışsız olduğu için reddedildi.

examples.en: Compared to her, I am very impractical.
examples.author: freddy1
examples.tr: Ona göre, çok elverişsizim.

defEn: Strongly affected, especially favourably.
Stamped, under pressure.

examples.en: I was impressed by the general knowledge of Japanese students.
examples.author: spockofvulcan
examples.tr: Japon öğrencilerin genel kültür bilgisinden etkilendim.

examples.en: We were very impressed by his new book.
examples.author: CH
examples.tr: Onun yeni kitabından oldukça etkilenmiştik.

examples.en: I was most impressed by his good behavior.
examples.author: CM
examples.tr: Onun iyi davranışından çok etkilendim.

defEn: An art movement characterized by visible brushstrokes, ordinary subject matter, and an emphasis on light and its changing qualities.
A style that avoided traditional harmony, and sought to invoke the impressions of the composer.

examples.en: Monet's art is representative of Impressionism.
examples.author: Dejo

defEn: One who adheres to the theory or method of impressionism.
A performer who does impressions; a mimic.

examples.en: The lecture on the Impressionist painters was interesting.
examples.tr: Empresyonist ressamlar üzerine olan konferans ilginçti.

examples.en: Claude Monet was a famous impressionist painter.
examples.author: Eccles17
examples.tr: Claude Monet ünlü bir izlenimci ressamdı.

examples.en: That painting is a masterpiece of impressionist art.

defEn: To put in or as if in prison; confine somebody against their will.

examples.en: He ran the risk of being caught and imprisoned.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Yakalanma ve tutuklanma riskini göze aldı.

examples.en: The queen was imprisoned in the Tower of London.
examples.author: Hybrid
examples.tr: Kraliçe, Londra Kulesine hapsedildi.

examples.en: We shouldn't be imprisoning people for such petty crimes.
examples.author: ferra
examples.tr: Böyle basit suçlar yüzünden insanları hapse atmamamız lazım.

defEn: A confinement in a place, especially a prison or a jail, especially as punishment for a crime.

examples.en: Such an offence is punished by a fine and/or imprisonment.
examples.author: Swift
examples.tr: Böyle bir suç ceza ve / veya hapis ile cezalandırılır.

examples.en: The prosecutor had called for fifteen years' imprisonment.
examples.author: absvfx
examples.tr: Savcı on beş yıl hapis talebinde bulundu.

examples.en: The judge sentenced Tom to three years imprisonment.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Hakim Tom'u üç yıl hapis cezasına çarptırdı.

defEn: Not likely to be true.
Not likely to happen.

examples.en: Your explanation won't wash; it's too improbable to be true.
examples.author: Dejo
examples.tr: Açıklamanız inandırıcı olmayacak; o gerçek olamayacak kadar imkansız.

examples.en: Mathematically, everything's good. But it seems completely improbable to me.
examples.tr: Matematiksel olarak her şey iyi. Ama benim için tamamen muhtemel görünmüyor.

examples.en: It seemed improbable that Tom would succeed.
examples.author: Hybrid
examples.tr: Tom'un başarılı olacağını imkansız görünüyordu.

defEn: In an improper manner; not properly.

examples.en: Are you suggesting I behaved improperly?
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Uygunsuz davrandığımı mı düşünüyorsun?

examples.en: Any electrical device, if used improperly, has the potential for causing fire, electrical shock or personal injury.
They vote in secret, may seek public office, and may demand the removal of public officials who behave improperly.
examples.author: papabear

defEn: That has been made better; enhanced.

examples.en: Her communication skills could be improved.
examples.author: emory989
examples.tr: Onun iletişim becerileri geliştirilebilir.

examples.en: Computers are constantly being improved.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Bilgisayarlar sürekli geliştiriliyorlar.

examples.en: Almost everything has been improved.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Hemen hemen her şey iyileştirildi.

defEn: A thrust; a push; a sudden force that impels.
A wish or urge, particularly a sudden one prompting action.

examples.en: He told his wife not to buy on impulse.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Karısına düşünmeden almamasını söyledi.

examples.en: You people are urged to drop the earthly impulse.
examples.author: piterkeo
examples.tr: Siz insanlardan dünyevi dürtüleri bırakmanız isteniyor.

examples.en: I felt an impulse to cry out loud.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Yüksek sesle bağırmak için bir dürtü hissettim.

defEn: Having the power of driving or impelling; giving an impulse; moving; impellent.
Actuated by impulse or by transient feelings; inclined to make rapid decisions without due consideration.

examples.en: It's a bad time to be impulsive.
examples.author: CM
examples.tr: İtici olmak için kötü bir zaman.

examples.en: Tom is a little impulsive, isn't he?
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Tom biraz düşüncesiz, değil mi?

examples.en: Tom said that Mary was impulsive.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Tom, Mary'nin dürtüsel olduğunu söyledi.

defEn: Mistaken or incorrect; not accurate.

examples.en: The wall clock of the living room is inaccurate.
examples.author: Catriona
examples.tr: Oturma odasının duvar saati yanlış.

examples.en: The budget appears to be inaccurate and unrealistic.
examples.tr: Bütçe hatalı ve gerçek dışı görünüyor.

examples.en: That film was an extremely inaccurate portrayal of key historical events.
examples.author: Vanilla
examples.tr: O film önemli tarihsel olayların son derece yanlış bir tasviriydi.

defEn: Not adequate; lacking in quality or quantity required; insufficient for a purpose.

examples.en: Our school facilities are inadequate for foreign students.
examples.tr: Okul olanaklarımız yabancı öğrenciler için yetersizdir.

examples.en: Nutrition is inadequate in some poor areas.
examples.author: Source_VOA
examples.tr: Bazı fakir bölgelerde beslenme yetersiz.

examples.en: The road is inadequate for the amount of traffic which it carries.
examples.author: CM
examples.tr: Yol taşıdığı trafik miktarı için yetersizdir.

defEn: Lacking the quality or ability of motion; as an inanimate object.
Not alive, and never having been alive, especially not like humans and animals.

examples.en: Stop threatening inanimate objects, they can't hear you.
The spirits can be good or evil and can inhabit inanimate objects.
examples.author: Amastan

defEn: Innate; possessed by an organism at birth.
Inherited; hereditary.

examples.en: Linguistic competence is inborn, not acquired.
One's success in life has little to do with one's inborn gift.
examples.author: CM

examples.en: There is only one inborn error, and that is the notion that we exist in order to be happy.
examples.author: Adelpa

defEn: Biotic material that releases fragrant smoke when burnt, often used in religious rites or for aesthetic reasons.
The fragrant smoke released by burning incense (sense 1).

examples.en: She likes to burn incense while practising yoga.
examples.author: Hybrid
examples.tr: O yoga yaparken tütsü yakmayı sever.

examples.en: I don't usually burn incense at home.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Ben genellikle evde tütsü yakmam.

examples.en: Stop burning incense! I have asthma.
examples.author: Eccles17
examples.tr: Tütsü yakmayı bırak! Astımım var.

defEn: Something that motivates, rouses, or encourages.
A bonus or reward, often monetary, to work harder.

examples.en: He was incensed by their lack of incentives.
examples.author: shekitten
examples.tr: O, onların teşviklerinin eksikliği tarafından kızdırıldı.

examples.en: She had no incentive to work after she was refused a promotion.
examples.author: CM
examples.tr: Onun terfi alamadıktan sonra çalışma isteği kalmadı.

examples.en: Incentives always help.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Teşvikler her zaman yardımcı olur.

defEn: To advance very slowly, or by a small amount (in a particular direction).
To drive by inches, or small degrees.

examples.en: I've grown two inches this summer.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Bu yaz iki inç büyüdüm.

examples.en: His long nose became at least two inches longer.
examples.author: Hybrid
examples.tr: Onun uzun burnu en az iki inç daha uzun hale geldi.

examples.en: He is three inches taller than his wife is.
examples.author: ET
examples.tr: Karısından üç inç daha uzun.

defEn: To bring upon oneself or expose oneself to, especially something inconvenient, harmful, or onerous; to become liable or subject to.
To render (somebody, or oneself) liable or subject to.

examples.en: You do not want to incur the wrath of God.
examples.author: darinmex
examples.tr: Sen Tanrının gazabına uğramak istemezsin.

examples.en: The company incurred a deficit of $400 million during the first quarter.
examples.author: Dejo
examples.tr: Şirket ilk çeyrekte 400 milyon dolar açık verdi.

examples.en: If you are not careful, you will incur prohibitive expenses.
examples.author: AlanF_US

defEn: Of an illness, condition, etc, that is unable to be cured; healless.
Irremediable, incorrigible.

examples.en: The prostitutes here have an incurable form of syphilis.
examples.author: Eccles17
examples.tr: Buradaki fahişeler tedavi edilemeyen bir frengi formuna sahip.

examples.en: According to Tom's doctors, his condition is incurable.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Tom'un doktorlarına göre, onun durumu tedavisi imkansız.

examples.en: She suffers from an incurable disease.
examples.author: AlanF_US
examples.tr: O, çaresiz bir hastalıktan muzdarip.

defEn: Obligated, especially financially.
Owing gratitude for a service or favour.

examples.en: I don't like to be indebted to anyone.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Kimseye borçlu olmaktan hoşlanmıyorum.

examples.en: I feel indebted to you for your help during my illness.
examples.author: Zifre
examples.tr: Hastalığım sırasında yaptığınız yardım için size borçlu hissediyorum.

examples.en: I will always be indebted to you.
examples.author: Saumya
examples.tr: Daima sana medyun olacağım.

defEn: To notch; to jag; to cut into points like a row of teeth
To be cut, notched, or dented.

examples.en: Remove the tab at the beginning. The line should not be indented.
examples.author: AlanF_US

examples.en: The sea indented the coastline.
examples.author: bekindtoall

examples.en: to indent the edge of paper

defEn: In an independent manner.

examples.en: Tom and Bill arrived at the conclusion independently of each other.
examples.author: CP
examples.tr: Tom ve Bill birbirlerinden bağımsız olarak karara vardılar.

examples.en: Tom is independently wealthy.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Tom bağımsız olarak zengin.

examples.en: He's independently wealthy.
examples.author: Hybrid
examples.tr: O bağımsız olarak zengin.

defEn: Impossible (or very difficult) to describe.
Exceeding all description.

examples.en: The pain of losing a child is indescribable.
examples.author: CM
examples.tr: Bir çocuğu kaybetmenin acısı tarif edilemez.

examples.en: It was an indescribable situation.
examples.author: CannedBread
examples.tr: Bu tarifsiz bir durumdu.

examples.en: Her beauty is indescribable.
examples.author: yessoos
examples.tr: Onun güzelliği tarif edilemez.

defEn: An alphabetical listing of items and their location.
The index finger; the forefinger.

examples.en: The stock price index soared to an all-time high.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Hisse senedi fiyat endeksi, tüm zamanların en yükseğine yükseldi.

examples.en: His index finger is shorter than his ring finger.
examples.author: mervert1
examples.tr: Onun işaret parmağı yüzük parmağından daha kısadır.

examples.en: I use numbered index cards for each student.
examples.tr: Her öğrenci için numaralandırılmış dizin kartları kullanırım.

defEn: Ambivalent; unconcerned; uninterested, apathetic.
Indicating or reflecting a lack of concern or care.

examples.en: Lots of people in Japan are indifferent to politics.
examples.author: CM
examples.tr: Japonya'da bir sürü insan siyasete kayıtsız.

examples.en: I don't usually feel indifferent, but today is different.
examples.author: Eccles17
examples.tr: Genelde kayıtsız hissetmiyorum, fakat bugün farklıdır.

examples.author: al_ex_an_der
examples.tr: Polis konuya ilgisizdi.

defEn: degradation, debasement or humiliation
an affront to one's dignity or pride

examples.en: It is an indignity to take advantage of uneducated people.
examples.author: arh

examples.en: They expressed their indignity at the claims.
examples.author: Anon

examples.en: Jugurtha suffered the indignity of being paraded through the streets of Rome.
examples.author: Amastan

defEn: Absolutely necessary or requisite; that one cannot do without.
Unbendable, that cannot be set aside or ignored.

examples.en: Sleep and good food are indispensable to good health.
examples.author: shekitten
examples.tr: Uyku ve iyi yemek iyi sağlık için gereklidir.

examples.en: Nothing in this world is so indispensable as love.
examples.author: Hybrid
examples.tr: Bu dünyada hiçbir şey sevgi kadar vazgeçilmez değildir.

examples.en: Both air and water are indispensable for life.
examples.author: J_S
examples.tr: Hem hava hem de su hayat için vazgeçilmezdir.

defEn: A person considered alone, rather than as belonging to a group of people.
An object, be it a thing or an agent, as contrasted to a class.

examples.en: An individual is the smallest unit of the society.
examples.author: mamduhi
examples.tr: Bir birey toplumun en küçük birimidir.

examples.en: Collective punishment for individual crimes is an inadvisable strategy.
examples.author: mailohilohi
examples.tr: Bireysel suçlar için toplu ceza, tavsiye edilemez bir stratejidir.

examples.en: The consequence of individual crimes should be collective punishment.
examples.author: mailohilohi
examples.tr: Bireysel suçların sonucunun ortak cezalandırma olması gerekir.

defEn: To yield to a temptation or desire.
To satisfy the wishes or whims of.

examples.en: You can indulge yourself without spending a fortune.
examples.author: Adelpa
examples.tr: Bir servet harcamadan kendinizi şımartabilirsiniz.

examples.en: Most countries indulge in a little historical revisionism.
examples.author: Chrikaru
examples.tr: Birçok ülke biraz tarihsel revizyonizme izin verirler.

examples.en: Sometimes you can indulge yourself in some luxury.
examples.author: honestlang
examples.tr: Bazen kendinizi biraz lüksün içinde şımartabilirsiniz.

defEn: Disposed or prone to indulge, humor, gratify, or yield to one's own or another's desires, etc., or to be compliant, lenient, or forbearing.

examples.en: Tom gave a little indulgent smile.
examples.author: CM
examples.tr: Tom biraz hoşgörülü bir gülümseme verdi.

examples.en: Tom is quite helpful, indulgent even.
examples.author: megamanenm
examples.tr: Tom oldukça faydalı, üstelik hoşgörülü.

examples.en: I suppose we're a little too indulgent to the dog.

defEn: To develop industry; to become industrial.
To organize along industrial lines.

examples.en: Britain began to industrialise in the late eighteenth century.
examples.author: zumley
examples.tr: Britanya 18. yüzyılın sonlarında sanayileşmeye başlamıştır.

examples.en: The country was industrialized very quickly.
examples.author: CM
examples.tr: Ülke çok hızlı sanayileşti.

examples.en: Algeria tried to industrialize in the 1970s.
examples.author: Amastan
examples.tr: Cezayir 1970'li yıllarda sanayileşmeye çalıştı.

defEn: Not having the desired effect; ineffectual; otiose.
Lacking in ability; incompetent or inadequate.

examples.en: Luckily, the treatment was only ineffective instead of harmful.
examples.author: papabear
examples.tr: Neyse ki tedavi zararlı yerine sadece etkisizdi.

examples.en: Why is it that many language courses are ineffective?
examples.author: Eldad
examples.tr: Neden o birçok dil kursu etkisizdir?

examples.en: I consider paracetamol to be an ineffective medicine.
examples.author: Objectivesea
examples.tr: Ben parasetamolu etkisiz bir ilaç olarak görüyorum.

defEn: Unable to move or act; inanimate.
Sluggish or lethargic.

examples.en: It doesn't make any difference, guys. The balls are inert.
examples.author: Ooneykcall

examples.en: Nitrous oxide is inert at room temperature.
examples.author: shekitten

defEn: Not experienced; lacking knowledge because lacking experience.

examples.en: The problem is that she is inexperienced.
examples.author: Chrikaru
examples.tr: Sorun onun deneyimsiz olmasıdır.

examples.en: Inexperienced climbers often suffer with altitude sickness.
examples.author: zumley
examples.tr: Deneyimsiz dağcılar sıklıkla irtifa hastalığına yakalanırlar.

examples.en: Tom was quite inexperienced with girls before he met Mary.
examples.author: Hybrid
examples.tr: Tom Mary ile tanışmadan önce kızlara karşı oldukça çaylaktı.

defEn: A very young human being, from birth to somewhere between six months and two years of age after birth, needing almost constant care and attention.
A student in an infant school or the first part of a primary school.

examples.en: The infant has been exposed to radioactive rays.
examples.tr: Bebek, radyoaktif ışınlara maruz kalmıştır.

examples.en: The young woman was carrying an infant in her arms.
examples.author: CM
examples.tr: Genç kadın kollarında bir bebek taşıyordu.

examples.en: Infants are not conscious of good and evil.
examples.author: AlanF_US
examples.tr: Bebekler iyi ve kötünün farkında değildirler.

defEn: To bring (the body or part of it) into contact with a substance that causes illness (a pathogen), so that the pathogen begins to act on the body; (of a…
To contaminate (an object or substance) with a pathogen.

examples.en: The virus can easily infect a healthy person.
examples.author: unionprof
examples.tr: Virüs sağlıklı bir insanı kolayca enfekte edebilir.

examples.en: Fear infects and corrupts everything it touches.
examples.author: etala
examples.tr: Korku dokunduğu her şeye bulaşır ve bozar.

examples.en: A mass of maggots were infecting Gabriel's arm.
examples.author: Amastan

defEn: Having an infection.

examples.en: It seems that the computer was infected by a virus.
examples.author: WestofEden
examples.tr: Bilgisayara bir virüs bulaşmış gibi görünüyor.

examples.en: Tom thought his sheep were infected with foot-and-mouth disease.
examples.author: Amastan
examples.tr: Tom, koyununun şap hastalığına yakalandığını düşündü.

examples.en: The air was infected with photochemical smog.
examples.author: Zifre
examples.tr: Hava fotokimyasal sis ile enfekte edildi.

defEn: Spreading quickly from one person to another.
Memorable and invoking excitement or interest.

examples.en: Louis Pasteur discovered that germs cause most infectious diseases.
examples.author: Source_VOA
examples.tr: Louis Pasteur mikropların en bulaşıcı hastalıklara neden olduklarını keşfetti.

examples.en: Not all the infectious diseases are contagious.
examples.author: Muelisto
examples.tr: Tüm bulaşıcı hastalıklar bulaşıcı değildir.

examples.en: The new coronavirus is very infectious.
examples.author: Amastan
examples.tr: Yeni koronavirüs çok bulaşıcı.

defEn: To introduce (something) as a reasoned conclusion; to conclude by reasoning or deduction, as from premises or evidence.
To lead to (something) as a consequence; to imply.

examples.en: What do you infer from her strange behavior?
examples.author: AlanF_US
examples.tr: Onun garip davranışlarından ne çıkarıyorsun?

examples.en: What are you inferring?
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Sen ne sonuç çıkarıyordun?

examples.en: She inferred from his silence that he was angry.
examples.author: Zifre

defEn: The act or process of inferring by deduction or induction.
That which is inferred; a truth or proposition drawn from another which is admitted or supposed to be true; a conclusion; a deduction.

examples.en: Select the statements which are observations rather than inferences.
examples.author: Miktsoanit

examples.en: Type inference has three outputs whereas checking only has two.
examples.author: xrchz

examples.en: Is this an observation or an inference?
examples.author: Miktsoanit

defEn: The state of being inflamed.
A condition of any part of the body, consisting of congestion of the blood vessels, with obstruction of the blood current, and growth of morbid tissue. It is…

examples.en: Hypophysitis is an inflammation of the pituitary gland.
examples.author: RobinvanderVliet
examples.tr: Hipofizit, hipofiz bezinin bir enflamasyonudur.

examples.en: I'm afraid the inflammation is getting worse.
examples.author: sundown
examples.tr: Enflamasyonun kötüleşmesinden korkuyorum.

examples.en: Saturated fats cause inflammation.
examples.author: Eccles17
examples.tr: Doymuş yağlar inflamasyona neden olur.

defEn: Tending to inflame or provoke somebody.
Relating to, causing, or caused by inflammation.

examples.en: Stop being so inflammatory.
examples.author: CM
examples.tr: Bu kadar kışkırtıcı olmayı bırak.

examples.en: What the mayor is claiming is spurious and inflammatory.
examples.author: darinmex

examples.en: We don't allow inflammatory or provocative content in this forum.
examples.author: DJ_Saidez

defEn: To enlarge an object by pushing air (or a gas) into it; to raise or expand abnormally
To enlarge by filling with air (or a gas).

examples.en: Have you ever inflated a balloon as big as this one?
examples.author: Amastan
examples.tr: Sen hiç bunun kadar büyük bir balon şişirdin mi?

examples.en: The severe housing shortage is partly to blame for the inflated rents.
examples.author: Dejo
examples.tr: Yükselmiş kiralar için kısmen şiddetli konut sıkıntısı suçlanacaktır.

examples.en: I cannot inflate all these balloons.
examples.author: Amastan
examples.tr: Bütün bu balonları şişiremem.

defEn: An act, instance of, or state of expansion or increase in size, especially by injection of a gas or liquid.
Undue expansion or increase, as of academic grades.

examples.en: Does depreciation of the yen give rise to inflation?
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Yenin değer kaybetmesi enflasyona neden olur mu?

examples.en: The newspaper called for the government to stop inflation.
examples.author: orcrist
examples.tr: Gazete hükümetin enflasyonu durdurmasını istedi.

examples.en: Four percent inflation is forecast for this year.
examples.author: CM
examples.tr: Bu yıl için %4 enflasyon tahmin ediliyor.

defEn: To have an effect on by using gentle or subtle action; to exert an influence upon; to modify, bias, or sway; to persuade or induce.
To exert, make use of one's influence.

examples.en: We are influenced both by environment and by heredity.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Hem çevreden hem de kalıtımdan etkilendik.

examples.en: That way of thinking influenced a lot of people.
examples.author: rmccar1
examples.tr: O düşünce şekli birçok insanı etkiledi.

examples.en: The tides are influenced by the moon and the sun.
examples.tr: Gelgitler ay ve güneşten etkilenirler.

defEn: Having or exerting influence.

examples.en: He is very influential in the world of medicine.
examples.author: penguooo
examples.tr: O, ilaç dünyasında çok nüfuzlu.

examples.en: Candlemass is an influential Swedish doom metal band.
examples.author: sabretou
examples.tr: Candlemass etkileyici bir İsveçli doom metal grubudur.

examples.en: I don't think Tom is as influential as Mary.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Tom'un Mary kadar etkili olduğunu sanmıyorum.

defEn: An acute contagious disease of the upper airways and lungs, caused by a virus, which rapidly spreads around the world in seasonal epidemics.

examples.en: This medicine is no protection against influenza.
examples.tr: Bu ilacın gribe karşı hiçbir koruması yoktur.

examples.en: He is at the doctor for influenza.
examples.author: Zifre
examples.tr: O grip için doktorda.

examples.en: There were many cases of influenza.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Birçok grip vakası vardı.

defEn: Not formal or ceremonious.
Not in accord with the usual regulations.

examples.en: Informal diction is always full of mystery and surrealism.
examples.author: papabear
examples.tr: Resmi olmayan diksiyon her zaman gizem ve gerçeküstücülükle doludur.

examples.en: Algeria continues to be a largely informal economy.
examples.author: Amastan
examples.tr: Cezayir büyük ölçüde kayıt dışı bir ekonomi olmaya devam ediyor.

examples.en: It was only an informal party.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Bu sadece gayri resmî bir parti idi.

synonyms: not in accord with the usual regulations

defEn: To break or violate a treaty, a law, a right, etc.
To break in or encroach on something.

examples.en: The jury found that Samsung had infringed upon Apple's patents.
examples.author: Spamster
examples.tr: Jüri, Samsung'un Apple'ın patentini ihlal ettiğini öğrendi.

examples.en: Piper filed a bill to enjoin Brown from infringing two patents.
examples.author: hecko2

examples.en: They infringe on our basic freedoms.
examples.author: AlanF_US

defEn: A violation or breach, as of a law.
An encroachment on a right, a person, a territory, or a property.

examples.en: Copyright infringement is against the law.
examples.author: Hybrid
examples.tr: Telif hakkı ihlali, kanuna aykırıdır.

examples.en: The complaint against Apple over patent infringements was filed by Motorola, owned by Google.
examples.author: ondo
examples.tr: Google'a ait Motorola tarafından patent ihlalleri üzerine Apple'a karşı dava açıldı.

examples.en: Your thinking about my book is an infringement on my copyright.
examples.author: DJ_Saidez

defEn: To live or reside in.
To be present in.

examples.en: Most of the islands in this area are inhabited.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Bu alandaki adaların çoğu iskan edilmiş.

examples.en: Those tribes inhabit the desert all year round.
examples.tr: O kabileler tüm yıl boyunca çölde yaşarlar.

examples.en: The region has never been inhabited by people.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Bölgede insanlar hiç yaşamadı.

defEn: To receive (property, a title, etc.), by legal succession or bequest, usually after the previous owner's death.
To come into an inheritance.

examples.en: He inherited some hectares of land from his grandfather.
examples.author: mervert1
examples.tr: Dedesinden birkaç hektar arazi miras aldı.

examples.en: Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?
examples.author: Hybrid
examples.tr: Öğretmenim, sonsuz yaşamı miras olarak almak için ne yapayım?

examples.en: The entire colony will inherit the mutant DNA.
examples.author: marcelostockle
examples.tr: Tüm koloni mutant DNA'yı miras alacak.

defEn: Chronologically first, early; of or pertaining to the beginning, cause or origin.
Spatially first, placed at the beginning, in the first position; especially said of the first letter of a word.

examples.en: Initial readings indicate an influx of toxic chemicals.
examples.author: CM

examples.en: Please initial and send back to us.
Philosophy is the self-correction by consciousness of its own initial excess of subjectivity.
examples.author: tijlan

defEn: A beginning; a first move.
A new development; a fresh approach to something; a new way of dealing with a problem.

examples.en: The president urged employees to act on their initiative.
examples.author: fcbond
examples.tr: Başkan çalışanları kendi inisiyatifiyle hareket etmeye teşvik etti.

examples.en: I have no intention of financing such an initiative.
examples.author: Nuel
examples.tr: Böyle bir girişimi finanse etmek gibi bir niyetim yok.

examples.en: He is quite good at his job, but lacks initiative.
examples.author: CM
examples.tr: O işinde oldukça iyidir, ama inisiyatiften yoksundur.

defEn: The act of injecting, or something that is injected.
A specimen prepared by injection.

examples.en: I prefer taking medicine rather than getting an injection.
examples.author: sacredceltic
examples.tr: Ben iğne olmak yerine, ilaç almayı tercih ederim.

examples.en: The court condemned the man to death by lethal injection.
examples.author: darinmex
examples.tr: Mahkeme adamı öldürücü iğneyle ölüme mahkûm etti.

examples.en: I'm going to give you an injection of an analgesic.
examples.author: AlanF_US
examples.tr: Sana ağrı kesici bir enjeksiyon yapacağım.

defEn: Suffering from an injury.

examples.en: A lot of passengers were injured in the accident.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Kazada birçok yolcu yaralandı.

examples.en: Quite a few people were injured in the accident.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Kazada oldukça az sayıda kişi yaralandı.

examples.en: Dozens of people were injured in the terrible accident.
examples.author: CM
examples.tr: Korkunç kazada düzinelerle insan yaralandı.

defEn: Inborn; existing or having existed since birth.
Instinctive; coming from instinct.

examples.en: Generosity is innate in some people.
examples.author: Swift
examples.tr: Cömertlik bazı kişilerde doğuştandır.

examples.en: Even small children have an innate sense of what's fair and what's not.
examples.author: patgfisher
examples.tr: Küçük çocukların bile neyin adil olduğu ve neyin olmadığı konusunda doğuştan gelen bir duyusu vardır.

examples.en: Gauss had an innate talent for mathematical problems.

defEn: In an innocent manner.

examples.en: Tom smiled innocently.

examples.tr: Tom saf saf gülümsedi.

examples.en: Ziri and Rima were innocently flirting.
examples.author: Amastan

examples.en: Matthew was innocently presenting his show.
examples.author: Amastan

defEn: The act of innovating; the introduction of something new, in customs, rites, etc.
A change effected by innovating; a change in customs.

examples.en: Open source is the engine that drives technological innovation.
examples.tr: Açık kaynak; teknolojik yeniliği sağlayan motordur.

examples.en: Sami started a major innovation to the store.
examples.author: OsoHombre
examples.tr: Sami mağazada önemli bir yenileme başlattı.

examples.en: Thanks to technological innovations, maximum outputs of the factory have doubled.
examples.tr: Teknolojik yenilikler sayesinde, fabrikanın maksimum üretimi iki katına çıktı.

defEn: Characterized by the creation of new ideas or inventions.
Forward-looking; ahead of current thinking.

examples.en: They will use an innovative technique to perform such a task.
examples.author: Amastan
examples.tr: Onlar böyle bir görevi gerçekleştirmek için yenilikçi bir teknik kullanacaklar.

examples.en: Tom Jackson is the brain behind this very innovative car.
examples.author: Amastan
examples.tr: Tom Jackson bu çok yenilikçi arabanın arkasına beyin.

examples.en: Do you have an innovative idea?
examples.tr: Yenilikçi bir fikrin var mı?

defEn: The act or process of putting in; infusion.
That which is put in, as in an amount.

examples.en: Please input your PIN number.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Lütfen PIN numaranı gir.

examples.en: Any input would be appreciated!
examples.author: CE
examples.tr: Herhangi bir veri girişi takdir edilecektir!

examples.en: I may need your input.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Sözlerine ihtiyacım olabilir.

defEn: To ask (about something).
To make an inquiry or an investigation.

examples.en: The police are inquiring into his connections with the criminals.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Polis, suçlularla bağlantılarını araştırıyor.

examples.en: The police were inquiring into the suspect's past.
examples.author: CM
examples.tr: Polis şüphelinin geçmişini soruşturuyordu.

examples.en: I went to the hospital to inquire after his health.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Onun sağlığını sormak için hastaneye gittim.

defEn: Unable to be separated; bound together permanently.

examples.en: Good health is inseparable from exercise and moderation.
examples.tr: İyi sağlık egzersiz ve ılımlılıktan ayrılamaz.

examples.en: Tom and Mary were inseparable when they were children.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Tom ve Mary, çocukken çok yakınlardı.

examples.en: He and I have been inseparable friends since our student days.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Öğrencilik günlerimizden beri o ve ben ayrılmaz arkadaşlarız.

defEn: Of or pertaining to the inner surface, limit or boundary.
Nearer to the interior or centre of something.

examples.en: Who writes the fortunes that are inside fortune cookies?
examples.author: Hybrid
examples.tr: Fal kurabiyelerinin içinde bulunan falları kim yazıyor?

examples.en: I opened the box and looked inside.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Kutuyu açtım ve içine baktım.

examples.en: The greatest and most beautiful temple of man is inside himself.
examples.author: ulyssemc1
examples.tr: İnsanın en büyük ve en güzel tapınağı, insanın kendi içindedir.

defEn: The interior or inner part.
The left-hand side of a road if one drives on the left, or right-hand side if one drives on the right.

examples.en: I put my gloves on inside out by mistake.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Eldivenlerimi yanlışlıkla ters giydim.

examples.en: He had one of his socks on inside out.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Çoraplarından birini ters giydi.

examples.en: I think it's cruel to keep a cat inside.
examples.author: Spamster
examples.tr: Bence bir kediyi kapalı yerde tutmak acımasızcadır.

defEn: To examine critically or carefully; especially, to search out problems or determine condition; to scrutinize.
To observe the status or nature of an object beyond what is found obvious upon its initial presentation; to 'view within' the object.

examples.en: Once a week, the mother inspects her son's room.
examples.author: Source_VOA
examples.tr: Haftada bir kez anne oğlunun odasını denetler.

examples.en: If you don't mind, may we inspect your suitcase?
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Sakıncası yoksa, valizinizi kontrol edebilir miyiz?

examples.en: You should inspect the car well before you buy it.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Almadan önce arabayı iyice incelemelisin.

defEn: A person employed to inspect something.
A police officer ranking below superintendent.

examples.en: The inspector arrived at the school late on Monday morning.
examples.author: CM
examples.tr: Müfettiş pazartesi sabahı okula geç vakit geldi.

examples.en: The suspect told a lie to the inspector.
examples.tr: Şüpheli müfettişe bir yalan söyledi.

examples.en: Tom has been a safety inspector for three years.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Tom üç yıldır bir güvenlik müfettişi.

defEn: Having the ability to inspire.

examples.en: Her Berber poems are inspirational.
examples.author: Amastan
examples.tr: Onun Berberice şiirleri ilham verici.

examples.en: It was truly inspirational.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: O gerçekten ilham vericiydi.

examples.en: This is truly inspirational.
examples.author: CM
examples.tr: Bu gerçekten ilham vericidir.

defEn: At once; without delay.

examples.en: He was hit by a car and died instantly.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Bir araba tarafından çarpıldı ve anında öldü.

examples.en: The princess fell in love with the prince instantly.
examples.author: Hybrid
examples.tr: Prenses, anında prense aşık oldu.

examples.en: Instantly the girl saw her mother, she burst out crying.
examples.tr: Kız annesini görür görmez birden ağlamaya başladı.

defEn: To cause a quality to become part of someone's nature.
To pour in (medicine, for example) drop by drop.

examples.en: We must instill patriotism into the young people of today.
examples.author: AlanF_US
examples.tr: Biz bugünün genç insanlarına vatanseverlik aşılamalıyız.

examples.en: Parents work hard to develop, or instill, positive beliefs and values in their children.
examples.author: Delayedecholalia
examples.tr: Ebeveynler, çocuklarında pozitif inanç ve değerler geliştirmek veya bunları çocuklarına aşılamak için çok çalışırlar.

examples.en: Sami instilled respect for others in his children.
examples.author: OsoHombre

defEn: A natural or inherent impulse or behaviour.
An intuitive reaction not based on rational conscious thought.

examples.en: In art, as in love, instinct is good enough.
examples.author: Scott
examples.tr: Sanatta, aşktaki gibi, içgüdü yeterince iyidir.

examples.en: I should know by now to trust my instincts.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: İçgüdülerime güvenmeyi artık bilmeliyim.

examples.en: I wonder if I should trust my instincts.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Hislerime güvenmem gerekip gerekmediğini merak ediyorum.

defEn: A long-established organization or type of organization, particularly one involved with education, public service, or charity work.
A custom or practice of a society or community.

examples.en: We don't need a formal institution for preserving peace.

Information about a person, provided by someone (a referee) with whom they are well acquainted.

A much repeated comment, complaint, or saying.

A place providing safety, protection or shelter.

defEn: A steady look, a gaze.

examples.tr: Gerçekten ne demek istediğini açıklamaya çekiniyordu.

Used to draw special attention to a proposition.

examples.tr: Dan kiralık arabayı polis istasyonunun yanına park etti.

The act of drawing or rendering again on the display.

The act of replacing something.

A copy made at a smaller scale than the original.

To check; to keep back.

The involuntary rejection from consciousness of painful or disagreeable ideas, memories, feelings, or impulses.

To criticise, rebuke, or reprimand (someone), usually in a gentle and kind tone.

To make an extensive investigation into.

A building or portion thereof used as a home, such as a house or an apartment therein.

To hand over (something to someone), place into the care or control of another.

A written or oral declaration that one resigns.

An underground organisation engaged in a struggle for liberation from forceful occupation; a resistance movement.

A strong will; the state of being resolute.

To yield (something) to another, as when defeated.

To refine (gold, silver, etc.) in a test or cupel; to subject to cupellation.

To make a statement based on personal knowledge or faith.

Witness; evidence; proof of some fact.

Denoting ‘as much’, ‘no less’.

defEn: A subject, now especially of a talk or an artistic piece; a topic.
A concept with multiple instantiations.

defEn: Someone who constructs theories, especially in the arts or sciences.

defEn: Someone who provides therapy, usually professionally.
A psychotherapist specifically.

Specifically, psychotherapy.

examples.tr: Terapide çok zaman geçirdin mi?

defEn: After that time, from then on; thenceforth.
After that (the thing aforementioned).

defEn: An apparatus used to measure temperature.

A lengthy essay written to establish the validity of a thesis (sense 1.1), especially one submitted in order to complete the requirements for a non-doctoral…

defEn: In a thick manner.

defEn: The property of being thick (in dimension).
A measure of how thick (in dimension) something is.

defEn: The upper leg of a human, between the hip and the knee.
That part of the leg of vertebrates (or sometimes other animals) which corresponds to the human thigh in position or function; the tibia of a horse, the tarsus…

examples.tr: Onun uyluğunda bir kertenkele dövmesi var.

defEn: One who spends time thinking, contemplating or meditating.
An intellectual, such as a philosopher or theologian.

examples.author: Source_Benedict_1921

defEn: A form of narrative writing using verbs in the third person in order to give the impression that the action is happening to another person.
Used other than figuratively or idiomatically: see third, person.

defEn: A sensation of dryness in the throat associated with a craving for liquids, produced by deprivation of drink, or by some other cause (such as fear, excitement,…

examples.tr: Satın almadan önce evi iyice inceledik.

examples.tr: Zirveye vardığımda, ben tamamen bitkindim.

defEn: Despite that; however.
Used to intensify statements or questions; indeed.

examples.en: You look as though nothing has happened to you.

defEn: Demonstrating thought or careful consideration.
Demonstrating kindness or consideration for others.

Inconsiderate, inattentive.

Any of various natural (as spiderweb, etc.) or manufactured filaments (as glass, plastic, metal, etc.).

defEn: To provide with a tip; to cover the tip of.

examples.author: CM
examples.tr: Bagajını taşıdığı için oda görevlisine bahşiş vermeyi unutma.

examples.tr: Çöp boşaltmanın ABD'de gerekli olduğunu hatırlasan iyi olur.

defEn: To walk quietly with only the tips of the toes touching the ground.

examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Sessizce yatak odama gittim.

examples.en: He walked on tiptoe so that nobody would hear him.

examples.tr: O, kimse onu duymasın diye parmak uçlarına basarak yürüdü.

defEn: Causing fatigue or boredom; wearisome.

examples.tr: İş ona baştan güzel göründü ama sonra yorucu geldi.

defEn: The thin, horny, transparent plate covering the upper surface of the end of a toe.

examples.tr: Ayak tırnaklarına hiç oje sürdün mü?

examples.author: darinmex

defEn: To labour; work.
To struggle.

examples.en: Toil and worry caused his health to break down.
examples.author: AlanF_US
examples.tr: Çok çalışmak ve endişe onun sağlığının bozulmasına neden oldu.

examples.en: I've been toiling away in the kitchen all afternoon.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Bütün öğleden sonra mutfakta çalışıp çabalıyordum.

Tending to withstand or survive.

examples.author: sharptoothed
examples.tr: Tom dine karşı tutumunda çok hoşgörülüdür.

examples.en: Tom isn't as tolerant as he used to be.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Tom eskiden olduğu kadar hoşgörülü değil.

defEn: To allow or permit without explicit approval, usually if it is perceived as negative.
To bear, withstand.

examples.en: We will not tolerate anyone who engages in terrorism.

examples.tr: Teröre bulaşan hiç kimseye müsamaha göstermeyeceğiz.

examples.en: His pride wouldn't allow him to tolerate such insults.
examples.author: CM
examples.tr: Onun gururu böyle hakaretlere tahammül etmesine izin vermedi.

examples.en: I can tolerate cold weather but not hot weather.
examples.author: ismaximum
examples.tr: Soğuk havaya katlanabilirim ama sıcak havaya değil.

defEn: A fee paid for some liberty or privilege, particularly for the privilege of passing over a bridge or on a highway, or for that of vending goods in a fair,…
Loss or damage incurred through a disaster.

examples.en: We must pay a toll to drive on this road.

examples.tr: Bu yolda araba sürmek için para ödemeliyiz.

examples.en: You have to pay at the toll plaza.
examples.author: bandeirante
examples.tr: Ücretli geçiş gişesinde ödeme yapmak zorundasın.

examples.tr: En son ne zaman paralı bir yol kullandın?

defEn: A small building, or a room within one, for the remains of the dead, with walls, a roof, and (if it is to be used for more than one corpse) a door. It may be…
A pit in which the dead body of a human being is deposited.

examples.tr: İskender, Keyhüsrev'in mezarının açılmasını emretti.

defEn: The short ton of 2000 pounds (about 907 kg), 20 hundredweights of 100 pounds avoirdupois each.
The long ton of 2240 pounds (about 1016 kg), 20 hundredweights of 112 pounds avoirdupois each.

examples.tr: Bir sürü insan onu tanıyor gibi görünüyor.

examples.en: I have a ton of work to do today.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Bugün yapacak bir sürü işim var.

examples.en: I have a ton of food in my pantry.
